title: Đề 1 · Chuẩn Form FA26_C1
description: 30 câu trắc nghiệm chuẩn cấu trúc đề thi FE SSG105 mới nhất (Slide 1–54).

questions.question: What is a direct consequence of excluding people from team decisions?
options: It accelerates decision-making speed.
It reduces motivation and their sense of value.
It builds learner safety.
It increases interpersonal risk-taking.
questions.correct_answer: It reduces motivation and their sense of value.
questions.explanation: Slide 6 (Unit 2 - Psychological Safety): Khi gạt thành viên ra khỏi các quyết định của nhóm, họ sẽ cảm thấy ý kiến không được trân trọng, làm giảm động lực (motivation) và cảm giác có giá trị (sense of value).

questions.question: Why do courses use team projects?
options: To prepare students for working with others in their future career
To make students feel anxious and drained.
To evaluate students on individual tasks only
To replace the need for regular team meetings.
questions.correct_answer: To prepare students for working with others in their future career
questions.explanation: Slide 4 (Unit 2 - Class Team Projects): Mục đích thực sự của bài tập nhóm ở đại học là trải nghiệm học tập và chuẩn bị cho sinh viên kỹ năng làm việc cùng người khác trong sự nghiệp tương lai.

questions.question: What is NOT a characteristic of virtual leadership?
options: A shift from "presence" to "outcomes"
Guiding a team where the members are geographically dispersed
It is important for a leader to be highly attuned to subtle digital cues.
Trust can only be earned through face-to-face rapport.
questions.correct_answer: Trust can only be earned through face-to-face rapport.
questions.explanation: Slide 14 (Unit 4 - Virtual Leadership): Lãnh đạo từ xa chuyển trọng tâm từ 'sự hiện diện' sang 'kết quả' (outcomes) và vẫn xây dựng được niềm tin qua giao tiếp rõ ràng; quan điểm 'chỉ có thể tạo niềm tin qua gặp mặt trực tiếp' là SAI.

questions.question: What is NOT how Maslow’s hierarchy of needs can be applied to team management?
options: A leader cannot motivate a team member with psychological rewards if basic needs are not met.
Only when team members feel secure do they crave connection.
A leader should wait for annual reviews to praise team members as not to let them rest on their laurels.
It is essential to ensure safe working conditions for team members.
questions.correct_answer: A leader should wait for annual reviews to praise team members as not to let them rest on their laurels.
questions.explanation: Unit 4 - Chương 16 (Maslow trong quản lý): Lãnh đạo KHÔNG nên chờ đến kỳ đánh giá hàng năm mới khen ngợi nhân viên; cần ghi nhận kịp thời để duy trì động lực (đáp án C là hành động sai).

questions.question: Han finds an online article claiming human attention span fell to 8 seconds (shorter than a goldfish). What is the main problem with this resource?
options: It is irrelevant to the purpose of her essay.
It is an unverified Internet resource.
It represents personal opinions only.
It uses informal language.
questions.correct_answer: It is an unverified Internet resource.
questions.explanation: Slide 35 (Unit 11 - Research Resources): Bài viết trên mạng tuyên bố khả năng tập trung của con người tụt xuống 8 giây (thua cá vàng) là ví dụ điển hình về nguồn tin trực tuyến chưa được kiểm chứng (unverified Internet resource).

questions.question: What is unnecessary to be considered when choosing writing channels?
options: The sensitivity and privacy of the content
The physical distance between team members
The level of complexity of the information
Cultural norms and urgency
questions.correct_answer: The physical distance between team members
questions.explanation: Unit 11 - Chương 5.2 (Choosing Writing Channels): Khi chọn kênh giao tiếp bằng văn bản, cần xét đến độ nhạy cảm/bảo mật, mức độ phức tạp, chuẩn mực văn hóa và tính khẩn cấp; khoảng cách vật lý giữa các thành viên không phải yếu tố quyết định kênh văn bản.

questions.question: In which step of the problem-solving process does a group start to brainstorm ways to address challenges while focusing resources on actionable solutions?
options: Define the problem
Generate possible solutions
Implement the chosen solution
Establish criteria for solutions
questions.correct_answer: Generate possible solutions
questions.explanation: Unit 7 - Chương 21-22 (7 bước giải quyết vấn đề): Brainstorming (động não tìm kiếm các phương án khả thi) nằm ở bước 'Generate possible solutions' (Tạo ra các giải pháp khả thi).

questions.question: What is illustrated by the responses: "So you're saying I'm bad at my job?" or "Why are you always attacking me?"
options: Connecting feedback to personal preferences
Taking feedback personally
Acknowledging perspective
Practicing self-control
questions.correct_answer: Taking feedback personally
questions.explanation: Unit 7 - Chương 24 (Receiving Feedback): Phản ứng như 'Vậy ý bạn là tôi làm việc kém?' hay 'Sao lúc nào bạn cũng công kích tôi?' là lỗi vơ phản hồi vào cá nhân (Taking feedback personally).

questions.question: What is an example of defensive communication?
options: "It sounds like we have different approaches to managing this project."
"Help me understand your perspective."
"You are just looking for things to criticize me about."
"I realize I missed the deadline. I struggled to balance my priorities."
questions.correct_answer: "You are just looking for things to criticize me about."
questions.explanation: Unit 7 - Chương 24 (Defensive Communication): Câu nói 'You are just looking for things to criticize me about' mang tính đổ lỗi, quy chụp và phòng thủ (defensive communication).

questions.question: Which type of report presents information with a comprehensive analysis to solve problems, demonstrate relationships, or make recommendations?
options: Informational report
Relational report
Analytical report
Financial report
questions.correct_answer: Analytical report
questions.explanation: Slide 37 (Unit 12 - Analytical Report): Analytical report (báo cáo phân tích) trình bày thông tin kèm phân tích toàn diện nhằm giải quyết vấn đề, chỉ ra mối liên hệ hoặc đưa ra khuyến nghị (recommendations).

questions.question: What characterizes solicited proposals?
options: Initiated by the seller or writer without prior request
Flexible structure with no deadline
Written in response to a formal request (RFP)
Relying purely on an unsolicited persuasive hook
questions.correct_answer: Written in response to a formal request (RFP)
questions.explanation: Slide 9 (Unit 3 - Solicited Proposals): Solicited proposal (đề xuất theo yêu cầu) được viết nhằm phản hồi một lời mời thầu / yêu cầu chính thức (RFP - Request for Proposal) từ khách hàng.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the Subject line in an email?
options: It ensures the recipient grasps the core message quickly.
It demonstrates formal respect and avoids mixups.
It signals the sender's overall mood.
It is optional and can be left blank.
questions.correct_answer: It ensures the recipient grasps the core message quickly.
questions.explanation: Slide 7 (Unit 3 - Netiquette & Email): Mục đích chính của dòng tiêu đề (Subject line) trong email là giúp người nhận nắm bắt nhanh chóng thông điệp cốt lõi trước khi mở thư.

questions.question: How is "paraphrasing" correctly defined in the writing process?
options: Condensing the main points into a much shorter form
Copying exact phrases and placing them in quotation marks
Restating another writer's idea in your own words and roughly similar length
Using someone else's words without credit
questions.correct_answer: Restating another writer's idea in your own words and roughly similar length
questions.explanation: Slide 36 (Unit 12 - Paraphrasing): Paraphrasing là diễn đạt lại ý tưởng của tác giả khác bằng ngôn từ của chính mình với độ dài tương đương bản gốc (và bắt buộc phải trích dẫn nguồn).

questions.question: What is the main distinguishing factor of an analytical report compared to an informational report?
options: An analytical report focuses entirely on presenting raw data.
An analytical report interprets information and draws conclusions or recommendations.
An analytical report avoids using headings and visual aids.
An analytical report is strictly written for external legal regulators.
questions.correct_answer: An analytical report interprets information and draws conclusions or recommendations.
questions.explanation: Slide 40 (Unit 12 - Analytical vs Informational Report): Điểm khác biệt cốt lõi là Analytical report diễn giải dữ liệu để rút ra kết luận và khuyến nghị hành động, trong khi Informational report chỉ trình bày sự thật/dữ liệu.

questions.question: A writer evaluates two software options for the company by examining their distinct features and pricing. Which organizational pattern is being utilized?
options: Compare-contrast
Chronological
Problem-solution
Cause-effect
questions.correct_answer: Compare-contrast
questions.explanation: Slide 36 (Unit 12 - Organizational Patterns): Khi đánh giá hai phần mềm bằng cách đối chiếu tính năng và giá cả, tác giả đang sử dụng mẫu tổ chức So sánh – Đối chiếu (Compare-contrast).

questions.question: Changing "We need to improve our resources" to "We need to upgrade our server hardware" applies which principle of business writing?
options: Choosing concrete terms over abstract ones to prevent ambiguity.
Using strict grammatical rules to replace idioms.
Modifying cultural contexts for international standards.
Using emotional language to ensure high engagement.
questions.correct_answer: Choosing concrete terms over abstract ones to prevent ambiguity.
questions.explanation: Slide 34 (Unit 10 - Concrete Language): Đổi 'improve our resources' (trừu tượng) thành 'upgrade our server hardware' (cụ thể) áp dụng nguyên tắc chọn từ ngữ cụ thể (concrete terms) thay cho từ mơ hồ.

questions.question: An employee messages a close coworker: "Hey, are we still on for grabbing a bite after the shift?" Which writing style does this represent?
options: Colloquial, because it utilizes regional slang
Casual, because it involves everyday expressions in a familiar group context
Formal, because it maintains professional distance
Bureaucratic, because it focuses on official shift schedules
questions.correct_answer: Casual, because it involves everyday expressions in a familiar group context
questions.explanation: Slide 34 (Unit 10 - Writing Styles): Tin nhắn thân mật cho đồng nghiệp thân thiết ('Hey, are we still on for grabbing a bite...') thuộc văn phong Casual (thân mật trong nhóm quen thuộc).

questions.question: What is NOT a good way to practice empathy during conflict resolution?
options: Practice active listening
Use tactical reflection
Ask closed-ended questions
Separate validation from agreement
questions.correct_answer: Ask closed-ended questions
questions.explanation: Unit 7 - Chương 24 (Empathy Skills): Khi thực hành thấu cảm để giải quyết xung đột, cần lắng nghe tích cực, phản chiếu chiến thuật và đặt câu hỏi mở; đặt câu hỏi đóng (closed-ended questions) KHÔNG phải cách tốt.

questions.question: How can we practice adopting a leadership mindset so as to build our emotional intelligence?
options: Be a problem-finder
Making excuses
See the big picture
Prioritize comfort
questions.correct_answer: See the big picture
questions.explanation: Slide 19 (Unit 5 - Leadership Mindset & EQ): Để rèn tư duy lãnh đạo nhằm nâng cao trí tuệ cảm xúc (EQ), cần nhìn vào bức tranh toàn cảnh (See the big picture) thay vì soi mói lỗi hay đổ lỗi.

questions.question: How do blocking roles typically affect a team's ability to reach an agreement?
options: They accelerate the process by forcing quick decisions.
They may lead to conflict and failure in consensus-building.
They improve team chemistry during disagreements.
They have no measurable impact.
questions.correct_answer: They may lead to conflict and failure in consensus-building.
questions.explanation: Slide 3 (Unit 1 - Blocking Roles): Vai trò cản trở (Blocking roles) phá vỡ sự đồng thuận, làm phát sinh xung đột tiêu cực và khiến nhóm thất bại trong việc ra quyết định chung.

questions.question: Which of the following behaviors are specifically associated with task-facilitating roles?
options: Supporting motivation and empathy
Providing information, asking for information, and monitoring progress
Hindering individual contribution and reducing morale
Resolving interpersonal conflict
questions.correct_answer: Providing information, asking for information, and monitoring progress
questions.explanation: Slide 3 (Unit 1 - Task-facilitating Roles): Vai trò thúc đẩy công việc gồm cung cấp thông tin, hỏi thông tin làm rõ và theo dõi tiến độ (monitoring progress) để nhóm đạt mục tiêu.

questions.question: What is suitable when designing presentation slides?
options: Copy and paste whole paragraphs onto a slide
When explaining two distinct ideas, split them into two slides
Use low-contrast colors
Use more than two font families
questions.correct_answer: When explaining two distinct ideas, split them into two slides
questions.explanation: Slide 54 (Unit 8 - Presentation Slides): Khi thiết kế slide thuyết trình, nếu giải thích hai ý tách biệt thì nên chia thành hai slide riêng (mỗi slide 1 ý chính, chữ tối thiểu 24pt, độ tương phản cao).

questions.question: Tuan nods continuously with flat filler words ("Yeah... wow...") while looking at his feet. What can be inferred from his nonverbal signs?
options: Tuan does not focus on the conversation.
Tuan is genuinely listening.
Tuan thinks Manh is telling lies.
Tuan is jealous of Manh.
questions.correct_answer: Tuan does not focus on the conversation.
questions.explanation: Unit 8 - Chương 3.5 (Nonverbal Signals): Liên tục gật đầu với các từ đệm nhạt nhẽo ('Yeah... wow...') trong khi mắt nhìn xuống chân cho thấy người nghe đang mất tập trung, không thực sự lắng nghe.

questions.question: What is the core distinction between being "college-ready" and being "career-ready"?
options: College-ready involves manual labor; career-ready requires computational math.
College-ready means mastering software; career-ready means passing entry tests.
College-ready focuses on foundational academic skills; career-ready focuses on technical and professional field skills.
College-ready applies to residential students; career-ready to working adults.
questions.correct_answer: College-ready focuses on foundational academic skills; career-ready focuses on technical and professional field skills.
questions.explanation: Slide 43 (Unit 13 - Career Readiness): 'College-ready' tập trung vào kỹ năng học thuật nền tảng, còn 'Career-ready' tập trung vào năng lực chuyên môn, kỹ năng nghề nghiệp và làm việc thực tế.

questions.question: Which of the following elements should be EXCLUDED from a standard professional business résumé?
options: Professional email address and phone number
Personal details such as age, marital status, and a photograph
Relevant volunteer history and academic internships
Summary of core qualifications and hard skills
questions.correct_answer: Personal details such as age, marital status, and a photograph
questions.explanation: Slide 45 (Unit 13 - Résumé Standards): Theo chuẩn quốc tế, phải LOẠI BỎ các thông tin cá nhân dễ gây thiên kiến khỏi Résumé như tuổi tác, tình trạng hôn nhân và ảnh chân dung.

questions.question: When evaluating candidates who possess technical skills but lack strong oral communication and teamwork capabilities, how do modern employers view them?
options: They are prioritized because hard skills are the only attributes valued.
They are often rejected because broad soft skills are highly prioritized.
They are hired at a reduced baseline salary.
They are advised to switch to an arts degree.
questions.correct_answer: They are often rejected because broad soft skills are highly prioritized.
questions.explanation: Slide 3 & 43 (Unit 1 & 13 - Hiring Criteria): Nhà tuyển dụng hiện đại thường từ chối ứng viên có kỹ năng chuyên môn nhưng yếu giao tiếp và làm việc nhóm, vì kỹ năng mềm (soft skills) được ưu tiên hàng đầu.

questions.question: If an audience is struggling with basic physical survival or safety concerns, what happens if a speaker pitches a product based purely on self-actualization?
options: The presentation will fail because higher-level needs cannot effectively motivate until lower- level needs are met.
The audience will adapt quickly.
The pitch will succeed using scarcity principles.
The audience will reject the message due to ethics.
questions.correct_answer: The presentation will fail because higher-level needs cannot effectively motivate until lower- level needs are met.
questions.explanation: Slide 30 (Unit 9 - Maslow in Persuasion): Theo tháp nhu cầu Maslow, bài thuyết phục sẽ thất bại nếu người nói đánh vào nhu cầu bậc cao (self-actualization) trong khi khán giả chưa được đáp ứng các nhu cầu sinh lý/an toàn cơ bản.

questions.question: What is the recommended purpose of an "elevator speech"?
options: To be prepared to concisely communicate your value or an idea in a brief window of opportunity.
To provide a full, detailed project report to an investor in an elevator.
To force a stakeholder to make an immediate binding decision.
To introduce yourself to everyone at a networking event.
questions.correct_answer: To be prepared to concisely communicate your value or an idea in a brief window of opportunity.
questions.explanation: Slide 30 (Unit 9 - Elevator Speech): Mục đích của Elevator Speech (30–60 giây, ~100 từ) là truyền đạt súc tích giá trị bản thân hoặc ý tưởng cốt lõi trong một khoảng thời gian giao tiếp rất ngắn.

questions.question: In which case are face-to-face meetings preferred over online meetings?
options: Mapping out a completely new strategy
Project tracking
Routine status reporting
Geographically distributed team updates
questions.correct_answer: Mapping out a completely new strategy
questions.explanation: Slide 20 (Unit 6 - Meeting Channels): Họp trực tiếp (Face-to-face) được ưu tiên khi nhóm cần hoạch định chiến lược hoàn toàn mới hoặc giải quyết vấn đề phức tạp, nhạy cảm; các báo cáo tiến độ định kỳ có thể họp online hoặc gửi email.

questions.question: In a meeting, when a participant goes over time, how should the facilitator intervene professionally?
options: Do not intervene as the speaker has important things to share.
"Just so you know, we are past your time block... wrap up whenever."
"Sorry to break the flow, but we are three minutes over the allocated time. To honor the rest of the agenda, let's skip ahead to your final slide."
Express visible impatience without saying anything.
questions.correct_answer: "Sorry to break the flow, but we are three minutes over the allocated time. To honor the rest of the agenda, let's skip ahead to your final slide."
questions.explanation: Slide 20 (Unit 6 - Facilitating Meetings): Khi thành viên nói quá giờ, điều phối viên chuyên nghiệp cần khéo léo xin lỗi vì ngắt lời, thông báo đã quá thời gian quy định để tôn trọng lịch trình chung và mời chuyển sang slide cuối.

title: Đề 2 · 30 Câu Bẫy Tình Huống (Case Traps)
description: 30 câu tình huống thực tế dễ mất điểm kèm mẹo phân tích tránh bẫy chi tiết.

questions.question: During a sprint review, a junior developer notices that the senior architect's database schema will cause severe latency when user traffic scales. Although everyone else agrees with the architect, the junior developer speaks up and questions the design. Which level of psychological safety is this?
options: Inclusion safety
Learner safety
Contributor safety
Challenger safety
questions.correct_answer: Challenger safety
questions.explanation: Rất nhiều sinh viên chọn nhầm Contributor safety (đóng góp năng lực chuyên môn). Từ khóa cốt lõi ở đây là "speaks up and questions" (dám công khai phản biện người có quyền lực/số đông) → Chắc chắn là Challenger safety.

questions.question: Minh always submits his slides two days before every deadline and never misses a meeting. However, during discussions, he constantly interrupts teammates to boast about his GPA and refuses to listen to ideas that don't benefit his own section. Which component of the Trust Equation is lowering Minh's overall trustworthiness?
options: Low Reliability
Low Credibility
High Self-orientation
Low Intimacy
questions.correct_answer: High Self-orientation
questions.explanation: Minh luôn nộp bài đúng hạn nên Reliability rất cao. Yếu tố làm giảm tổng niềm tin T = (C + R + I) / S chính là thói ích kỷ, đề cao bản thân (Self-orientation nằm ở mẫu số, S càng cao thì T càng thấp).

questions.question: When a heated debate breaks out between two subgroups, Mai steps in and says: "Both sides make valid points about user security and app speed. What if we cache non-sensitive data so we satisfy both goals?" Which role is Mai playing?
options: Reality testing (Task-facilitating)
Harmonizing / Compromising (Relationship-building)
Enforcing (Task-facilitating)
Blocking role
questions.correct_answer: Harmonizing / Compromising (Relationship-building)
questions.explanation: Reality testing là đánh giá tính khả thi thực tế (thời gian/ngân sách). Đứng ra xoa dịu và đưa giải pháp dung hòa 2 bên xung đột thuộc nhóm Relationship-building roles (Harmonizer/Compromiser).

questions.question: A university class team is formed without an appointed team leader. Halfway through the semester, members are afraid to ask questions because one outspoken student mocks basic inquiries. Who is responsible for establishing psychological safety in this team?
options: Only the outspoken student
The course lecturer
Every member of the team
Whoever wrote the Team Charter
questions.correct_answer: Every member of the team
questions.explanation: Trong một nhóm không có leader chính thức, việc duy trì môi trường an toàn tâm lý là trách nhiệm của tất cả các thành viên trong nhóm.

questions.question: A team lead insists on approving every single sentence of her teammates' slides and micromanages how they format charts, causing missed deadlines and low morale. Which factor is eroding team performance?
options: Groupthink
Poor delegation by managers
Low entry status
Social loafing
questions.correct_answer: Poor delegation by managers
questions.explanation: Hành vi quản lý quá vụn vặt (micromanagement) và không biết ủy quyền được giáo trình chỉ định rõ là Poor delegation by managers.

questions.question: When the marketing department demands last-minute feature changes two days before launch, the engineering team lead negotiates with marketing to push those requests to Phase 2 so her developers can stay focused on testing. Which leadership function is she performing?
options: Managing internal paradoxes
Managing team boundaries (acting as a buffer)
Practicing transactional punishment
Encouraging groupthink
questions.correct_answer: Managing team boundaries (acting as a buffer)
questions.explanation: Trưởng nhóm đóng vai trò tấm đệm (buffer) che chắn cho thành viên khỏi các yêu cầu nhiễu từ bên ngoài là hoạt động Managing team boundaries.

questions.question: Newly promoted team lead Tuan still spends 90% of his time coding the hardest modules himself while ignoring conflicts among his four junior developers. What is Tuan's main mistake?
options: Relying too much on self-managing leadership
Failing to shift his focus from technical tasks as an individual contributor to managing people and relationships
Over-delegating his responsibilities
Focusing too heavily on external stakeholders
questions.correct_answer: Failing to shift his focus from technical tasks as an individual contributor to managing people and relationships
questions.explanation: Sai lầm phổ biến nhất của người mới lên quản lý là vẫn sa đà vào chuyên môn kỹ thuật thay vì chuyển hướng sang quản trị con người và mối quan hệ.

questions.question: A manager gives detailed step-by-step checklists to a new intern during week one, provides occasional coaching in month three, and grants full autonomy over client accounts in month eight. Which leadership approach is illustrated?
options: Transactional leadership
Situational leadership
Autocratic leadership
Virtual leadership
questions.correct_answer: Situational leadership
questions.explanation: Thay đổi phong cách quản lý tùy thuộc vào độ trưởng thành và năng lực của nhân viên theo thời gian chính là Situational leadership.

questions.question: A teammate tells you: "I'm stuck on the financial projection table and don't know where to start." Following the "Leader-as-Coach" approach, what should you say?
options: "Send me the file; I'll build the table for you tonight."
"You should copy the table from Slide 12 and change the numbers."
"What is the biggest hurdle you're facing right now, and what data do we already have?"
"Why didn't you ask for help earlier?"
questions.correct_answer: "What is the biggest hurdle you're facing right now, and what data do we already have?"
questions.explanation: Nguyên tắc của Leader-as-Coach là không làm hộ (A) hay áp đặt giải pháp (B), mà đặt câu hỏi mở để gợi mở suy nghĩ cho đối phương.

questions.question: Which of the following statements demonstrates the highest Emotional Intelligence (EI) during a tense meeting?
options: "I'm fine, just do whatever you want."
"You never listen to anyone else's ideas in this group."
"I feel frustrated when my points are cut off before I finish explaining, because I want us to consider all options."
"Why are you always attacking my proposals?"
questions.correct_answer: "I feel frustrated when my points are cut off before I finish explaining, because I want us to consider all options."
questions.explanation: Giao tiếp bằng câu "I-statement" (bày tỏ cảm xúc và giải thích lý do khách quan) là dấu hiệu tiêu biểu của EQ cao, thay vì dùng "You-statement" đổ lỗi.

questions.question: A member forgot to upload the final survey link on Monday, causing the team to lose two days of data collection. Which feedback from the leader is goal-directed?
options: "You are really careless and let the whole team down."
"Don't worry about it at all, Monday wasn't important anyway."
"Our team's target is to collect 100 responses by Friday. Because the link went up two days late, we are currently behind that goal and need a catch-up plan."
"I felt embarrassed telling our mentor we hadn't started the survey yet."
questions.correct_answer: "Our team's target is to collect 100 responses by Friday. Because the link went up two days late, we are currently behind that goal and need a catch-up plan."
questions.explanation: Goal-directed feedback tập trung chiếu chiếu hành vi sai sót vào mục tiêu chung của dự án (target) và tìm phương án bù đắp.

questions.question: During a disagreement over project scope, Lan says: "I understand why you're worried that adding a mobile version will overload our schedule, and that's a fair concern. However, based on user feedback, I still believe we need a basic mobile view." What conflict skill is Lan using?
options: Avoiding conflict
Separating validation from agreement
Defensive communication
Groupthink
questions.correct_answer: Separating validation from agreement
questions.explanation: Thừa nhận mối lo ngại của đối phương là hợp lý (Validation) không đồng nghĩa với việc chấp nhận từ bỏ quan điểm chuyên môn của mình (Agreement).

questions.question: In which scenario is holding a synchronous group meeting UNNECESSARY?
options: The team needs to pivot their entire project topic after failing the proposal defense
Engineering and Design disagree on core app features
One member needs to compile a list of 10 local NGOs from Google for tomorrow's discussion
The team is resolving a major conflict over unequal workload distribution
questions.correct_answer: One member needs to compile a list of 10 local NGOs from Google for tomorrow's discussion
questions.explanation: Nhiệm vụ tra cứu thông tin cá nhân là công việc đơn lẻ, chỉ cần cập nhật qua chat/email, tổ chức cuộc họp trực tiếp là không cần thiết.

questions.question: What is the critical error in this meeting minute entry: "Huy stubbornly wasted 15 minutes whining about the budget and rudely dismissed An's brilliant marketing idea"?
options: Missing the date and location
Introducing subjective editorial bias and emotional language
Over-using technical abbreviations
Following chronological order
questions.correct_answer: Introducing subjective editorial bias and emotional language
questions.explanation: Biên bản cuộc họp phải duy trì tính khách quan 100%. Dùng các từ cảm tính như "stubbornly", "whining", "brilliant" là vi phạm nghiêm trọng lỗi editorial bias.

questions.question: You need to send a formal, permanent record of a new warranty policy to an external corporate client. Which channel is most appropriate?
options: An instant text message
An internal memorandum
A formal business letter
A casual verbal hallway chat
questions.correct_answer: A formal business letter
questions.explanation: Memo chỉ lưu hành nội bộ (internal); đối với đối tác/khách hàng bên ngoài (external), văn bản trang trọng luôn là Business Letter.

questions.question: Which combination of salutation and complimentary close is correctly formatted for a formal business letter?
options: Dear Ms. Tran, ... Sincerely:
Dear Ms. Tran: ... Sincerely,
To whom it may concern, ... Cheers!
Hi Ms. Tran: ... Best.
questions.correct_answer: Dear Ms. Tran: ... Sincerely,
questions.explanation: Trong thư thương mại chuẩn (Formal Business Letter): Sau lời chào dùng dấu hai chấm (:), sau lời kết dùng dấu phẩy (,).

questions.question: A startup notices that FPT campuses have long cafeteria queues and proactively emails the campus director a 2-page proposal for a pre-order food app, even though no RFP was posted. This is an example of:
options: A solicited proposal
An unsolicited proposal
A mid-project progress report
A descriptive abstract
questions.correct_answer: An unsolicited proposal
questions.explanation: Gửi đề xuất chủ động khi khách hàng không đưa ra yêu cầu mời thầu (RFP) chính là Unsolicited proposal.

questions.question: When can a business proposal safely omit a detailed Marketing Plan?
options: When launching a consumer mobile app that needs 10,000 student downloads
When bidding on a one-time contract to supply 500 office chairs to a single company
When proposing a community recycling campaign requiring public participation
When pitching a new subscription e-learning platform
questions.correct_answer: When bidding on a one-time contract to supply 500 office chairs to a single company
questions.explanation: Hợp đồng đấu thầu giao hàng cố định cho 1 bên duy nhất (bidding on a gross lot of supplies) không đòi hỏi thu hút công chúng nên không cần Marketing Plan.

questions.question: Changing "We had a great increase in sales recently" to "Our Q3 software revenue grew by 18% compared to Q2" applies which principle of written communication?
options: Using colloquial idioms for warmth
Choosing concrete, specific terms over abstract, vague ones
Avoiding active voice
Relying on emotional pathos
questions.correct_answer: Choosing concrete, specific terms over abstract, vague ones
questions.explanation: Thay thế các từ ngữ mơ hồ (great, recently) bằng dữ liệu định lượng cụ thể chính là nguyên tắc chọn concrete terms.

questions.question: Which style level is characterized by regional expressions, slang, and everyday speech not suitable for formal reports?
options: Formal
Informal
Casual
Colloquial
questions.correct_answer: Colloquial
questions.explanation: Colloquial là cấp độ ngôn ngữ đời thường/tiếng lóng địa phương; phân biệt với Casual (thân mật giữa bạn bè) và Formal (chuẩn mực báo cáo).

questions.question: A student reads a 150-word paragraph from a Harvard Business Review article, rewrites the entire idea in her own 145 words without copying any exact phrases, and includes it in her report without citing the source. What has she committed?
options: Proper summarizing
Ethical paraphrasing
Plagiarism
Descriptive abstracting
questions.correct_answer: Plagiarism
questions.explanation: Dù đã diễn đạt hoàn toàn bằng văn phong cá nhân (paraphrase), nếu không ghi rõ nguồn trích dẫn thì vẫn cấu thành hành vi Đạo văn (Plagiarism).

questions.question: Before submitting a group report, Minh checks whether the thesis is clear, the sections flow logically, and all counterarguments are addressed—leaving comma and spelling checks for later. What is Minh doing?
options: Editing
Revision
Proofreading
Citation formatting
questions.correct_answer: Revision
questions.explanation: Revision tập trung vào cấu trúc tổng thể, luận điểm và tính logic; còn Editing/Proofreading mới sửa chi tiết lỗi chính tả và dấu câu.

questions.question: You read a report abstract that states the research topic, methodology, and key data collected, but intentionally leaves out the final conclusions and recommendations. What type of abstract is this?
options: Informational abstract
Descriptive abstract
Executive proposal
Analytical memo
questions.correct_answer: Descriptive abstract
questions.explanation: Descriptive abstract chỉ mô tả chủ đề/phương pháp mà không đưa ra kết luận; trái lại Informational abstract tóm tắt trọn vẹn cả kết quả và khuyến nghị.

questions.question: A team is two weeks behind schedule on their capstone project, but in their Mid-Project Progress Report they write: "Everything is going smoothly and we anticipate zero issues," hoping to catch up secretly. Which common pitfall is this?
options: Providing too much raw data without charts
Being overly optimistic and hiding problems from stakeholders
Using too many headings
Writing in the first person
questions.correct_answer: Being overly optimistic and hiding problems from stakeholders
questions.explanation: Che giấu rủi ro và trễ tiến độ vì quá lạc quan là sai lầm nguy hiểm nhất khi thực hiện báo cáo tiến độ.

questions.question: At the end of the semester, after the community project has completely finished, the team analyzes survey scores to determine whether the project achieved its original objectives. Which type of evaluation is this?
options: Pre-project (Ex-ante) evaluation
Formative evaluation
Summative evaluation
Process evaluation
questions.correct_answer: Summative evaluation
questions.explanation: Đánh giá diễn ra sau khi kết thúc toàn bộ dự án để đo lường thành quả là Summative evaluation; còn đánh giá trong khi triển khai để điều chỉnh là Formative.

questions.question: In a persuasive pitch, a presenter organizes her arguments in a clear cause-and-effect sequence backed by peer-reviewed statistics and ROI calculations. Which appeal is she primarily using?
options: Pathos
Logos
Scarcity
Social penetration
questions.correct_answer: Logos
questions.explanation: Dựa trên lập luận logic, bằng chứng nghiên cứu và số liệu định lượng ROI luôn luôn là Logos.

questions.question: A speaker tries to sell a luxury leadership retreat focused on "self-actualization" to factory workers who are currently worried about layoffs and paying rent. Why does the pitch fail?
options: It lacks an elevator hook
Higher-level needs cannot motivate an audience whose basic safety and physiological needs are unmet
It violates the principle of reciprocity
It uses too many concrete terms
questions.correct_answer: Higher-level needs cannot motivate an audience whose basic safety and physiological needs are unmet
questions.explanation: Tháp Maslow chỉ ra rằng người nghe sẽ không quan tâm đến nhu cầu bậc cao (khẳng định bản thân) nếu các nhu cầu thiết yếu căn bản (an toàn tài chính, việc làm) chưa được thỏa mãn.

questions.question: During a Q&A session, a presenter rolls her eyes when a panelist asks a basic question, and then immediately apologizes. Why can't the presenter undo the negative impression?
options: Because nonverbal communication is arbitrary
Because nonverbal communication is irreversible
Because artifacts are permanent
Because verbal words override facial expressions
questions.correct_answer: Because nonverbal communication is irreversible
questions.explanation: Một trong những tính chất quan trọng của giao tiếp phi ngôn ngữ là Irreversible (không thể thu hồi lại được một khi đã phát ra).

questions.question: Which of the following items should be REMOVED from an entry-level graduate's résumé before applying to an international company?
options: Bullet points starting with past-tense action verbs
Relevant university capstone projects
A headshot photo, marital status, abbreviations, and expected monthly salary
A professional email address using their real name
questions.correct_answer: A headshot photo, marital status, abbreviations, and expected monthly salary
questions.explanation: Theo tiêu chuẩn quốc tế trong Slide 45, CV ứng tuyển nghiêm cấm chèn ảnh cá nhân, tình trạng hôn nhân/tuổi tác, từ viết tắt và mức lương kỳ vọng để chống phân biệt đối xử.

questions.question: An applicant copies the exact work experience bullet points from her résumé into the middle paragraphs of her cover letter. Why will recruiters view this negatively?
options: Because cover letters should never mention past experience
Because a cover letter should tell a deeper narrative connecting 2–3 key experiences (using STAR) to the specific role rather than repeating the résumé word-for-word
Because cover letters must be at least three pages long
Because STAR should only be used on the cover page of a proposal
questions.correct_answer: Because a cover letter should tell a deeper narrative connecting 2–3 key experiences (using STAR) to the specific role rather than repeating the résumé word-for-word
questions.explanation: Cover letter không phải bản sao chép CV mà là câu chuyện kết nối 2–3 trải nghiệm nổi bật nhất (áp dụng mô hình STAR) phù hợp với vị trí tuyển dụng.

title: Đề 3 · Ôn Tập Lý Thuyết & Thuật Ngữ
description: 30 câu kiểm tra chắc chắn kiến thức trọng tâm các chương 1–13.

questions.question: What primarily distinguishes a "Team" from a "Group" in organizational behavior?
options: Members work independently toward individual goals and individual evaluation.
Members share complementary skills, a common goal, and mutual accountability.
A team always has at least 20 members working in different time zones.
A group requires a formal Team Charter while a team does not.
questions.correct_answer: Members share complementary skills, a common goal, and mutual accountability.
questions.explanation: Slide 1–3 (Unit 1 - Team vs Group): Team khác Group ở chỗ các thành viên có kỹ năng bổ trợ (complementary skills), cùng hướng tới mục tiêu chung và cùng chịu trách nhiệm (shared accountability).

questions.question: Which driver of group cohesiveness explains why smaller teams generally exhibit higher satisfaction?
options: Size
Exclusiveness
Success
External Competition
questions.correct_answer: Size
questions.explanation: Slide 2 (Unit 1 - Group Cohesiveness): Trong 5 yếu tố gắn kết nhóm (Size, Similarity, Success, Exclusiveness, Competition), Size (quy mô) giải thích vì sao nhóm càng nhỏ thì mức độ hài lòng và gắn kết càng cao.

questions.question: A team member constantly challenges other members' ideas aggressively, stalling decision- making. What role are they performing?
options: Task-facilitating role
Relationship-building role
Blocking role
Executive role
questions.correct_answer: Blocking role
questions.explanation: Slide 3 (Unit 1 - Member Roles): Thành viên liên tục phản bác gay gắt ý tưởng người khác và làm đình trệ tiến độ ra quyết định đang đóng vai trò cản trở (Blocking role).

questions.question: In the Trust Equation T = (Credibility + Reliability + Intimacy) / Self-Orientation, what happens to trust when Self-Orientation increases?
options: Trust increases proportionally.
Trust remains unchanged.
Trust decreases significantly because self-orientation is in the denominator.
Intimacy is eliminated completely.
questions.correct_answer: Trust decreases significantly because self-orientation is in the denominator.
questions.explanation: Slide 5 (Unit 2 - Trust Equation): Trong công thức T = (Credibility + Reliability + Intimacy) / Self-Orientation, sự vị kỷ (Self-Orientation) nằm ở mẫu số; mẫu số càng tăng thì niềm tin T càng giảm mạnh.

questions.question: Which stage of Psychological Safety allows members to feel safe asking questions, experimenting, and making mistakes without fear of punishment?
options: Inclusion safety
Learner safety
Contributor safety
Challenger safety
questions.correct_answer: Learner safety
questions.explanation: Slide 6 (Unit 2 - Psychological Safety): Learner safety là giai đoạn thành viên cảm thấy an tâm đặt câu hỏi, thử nghiệm cái mới và mắc lỗi để học hỏi mà không sợ bị chê cười hay trừng phạt.

questions.question: What is the recommended maximum number of paragraphs for a standard business email message?
options: 1 paragraph
3 paragraphs
5 paragraphs
10 paragraphs
questions.correct_answer: 3 paragraphs
questions.explanation: Slide 7 (Unit 3 - Business Email): Một email công việc chuẩn mực nên trình bày ngắn gọn, tối đa 3 đoạn văn ngắn (maximum 3 paragraphs) kèm Subject line rõ ràng.

questions.question: When communicating written business information to an external client or partner, which format should be used?
options: Internal Memorandum
Business Letter
Casual Text Message
Meeting Minutes
questions.correct_answer: Business Letter
questions.explanation: Slide 7–8 (Unit 3 - Memos vs Letters): Memo dùng cho giao tiếp nội bộ; khi gửi văn bản chính thức cho khách hàng hoặc đối tác bên ngoài (external), phải dùng Business Letter.

questions.question: In a self-managing team structure, what is the primary role of the team leader?
options: Micro-manage daily step-by-step tasks.
Define overall goals while allowing members to self-regulate daily operations.
Perform all technical tasks independently.
Make all operational decisions without consulting members.
questions.correct_answer: Define overall goals while allowing members to self-regulate daily operations.
questions.explanation: Slide 13–14 (Unit 4 - Self-Managing Teams): Trong nhóm tự quản (Self-managing team), trưởng nhóm định hướng mục tiêu chung còn các thành viên tự chủ điều hành công việc hằng ngày.

questions.question: Why are "I" statements preferred over "You" statements during emotionally tense team discussions?
options: "I" statements sound more authoritative.
"I" statements reduce defensiveness by expressing personal perspective rather than attacking the listener.
"You" statements are illegal in professional environments.
"I" statements shift responsibility away from the speaker.
questions.correct_answer: "I" statements reduce defensiveness by expressing personal perspective rather than attacking the listener.
questions.explanation: Slide 19 (Unit 4 - EQ & 'I' Statements): Câu cấu trúc 'I' ('Tôi cảm thấy...') giúp bày tỏ góc nhìn cá nhân một cách khách quan, giảm thái độ phòng thủ thay vì công kích bằng câu 'You' ('Bạn luôn...').

questions.question: What should be strictly avoided when writing official meeting minutes?
options: Action items and assigned owners
Date, time, and attendee list
Subjective opinions and emotional comments about participants
Key decisions approved by the team
questions.correct_answer: Subjective opinions and emotional comments about participants
questions.explanation: Slide 20 (Unit 5 - Meeting Minutes): Biên bản cuộc họp (Meeting Minutes) phải tuyệt đối khách quan, chỉ ghi nhận quyết định và đầu việc; CẤM đưa nhận xét chủ quan hay ngôn từ cảm xúc.

questions.question: What is the best seating arrangement to foster open collaboration and equal interaction in face-to-face meetings?
options: Classroom style facing a podium
Round table seating
Linear single-file seating along a hallway
Auditoriums with fixed seating
questions.correct_answer: Round table seating
questions.explanation: Slide 20 (Unit 6 - Meeting Facilitation): Bố trí bàn tròn (Round table seating) là cách sắp xếp tốt nhất để khuyến khích trao đổi cởi mở và bình đẳng trong các cuộc họp trực tiếp.

questions.question: What is the first step in the 7-step systematic problem-solving process?
options: Generate solutions
Define the problem clearly
Select the best alternative
Evaluate results
questions.correct_answer: Define the problem clearly
questions.explanation: Unit 7 - Chương 21-22 (Problem Solving): Bước đầu tiên (Step 1) trong quy trình 7 bước giải quyết vấn đề có hệ thống là xác định rõ vấn đề (Define the problem clearly).

questions.question: What rule is critical during the initial phase of effective brainstorming?
options: Immediately criticize weak ideas.
Prioritize quantity of ideas and suspend judgment.
Allow only the leader to offer suggestions.
Require full financial estimates for every idea immediately.
questions.correct_answer: Prioritize quantity of ideas and suspend judgment.
questions.explanation: Unit 7 (Brainstorming Rules): Quy tắc sống còn ở giai đoạn đầu của Brainstorming là ưu tiên số lượng ý tưởng và tạm hoãn phán xét (suspend judgment).

questions.question: Which persuasive appeal focuses on establishing the speaker's credibility, character, and expertise?
options: Pathos
Ethos
Logos
Chronos
questions.correct_answer: Ethos
questions.explanation: Slide 30 (Unit 8 - Aristotle's Pillars): Trong 3 trụ cột thuyết phục (Ethos, Logos, Pathos), Ethos là yếu tố xây dựng uy tín, nhân cách và năng lực chuyên môn của người nói.

questions.question: When designing presentation slides, what is a recommended design guideline?
options: Fill every slide with full paragraphs of text.
Use strong visual contrast and limit each slide to one core idea.
Include at least 5 different font styles per slide.
Avoid using bullet points altogether.
questions.correct_answer: Use strong visual contrast and limit each slide to one core idea.
questions.explanation: Slide 54 (Unit 8 - Slide Design): Quy tắc thiết kế slide hiệu quả: sử dụng độ tương phản màu sắc cao (high contrast) và giới hạn mỗi slide chỉ truyền tải một ý cốt lõi.

questions.question: What is the standard ideal duration of a professional elevator speech?
options: 5–10 seconds
30–60 seconds
5–10 minutes
15–20 minutes
questions.correct_answer: 30–60 seconds
questions.explanation: Slide 30 (Unit 9 - Elevator Speech): Thời lượng chuẩn mực của một bài Elevator Speech chuyên nghiệp là 30–60 giây (khoảng 100 từ).

questions.question: Which phrase represents concrete, specific business writing?
options: "Sales improved significantly recently."
"Q3 revenue grew by 14.5% compared to Q2."
"Things are going well with our stuff."
"We will complete tasks as soon as possible."
questions.correct_answer: "Q3 revenue grew by 14.5% compared to Q2."
questions.explanation: Slide 34 (Unit 10 - Concrete Business Writing): Câu 'Q3 revenue grew by 14.5% compared to Q2' sử dụng số liệu định lượng cụ thể (Concrete), tránh từ ngữ mơ hồ như 'significantly', 'stuff', 'ASAP'.

questions.question: When paraphrasing information from a secondary academic source into your business report, what must you do?
options: No citation is needed since the words were changed.
Include a proper in-text citation and reference entry.
Change only one word per sentence to avoid citing.
Put the entire paraphrased section in quotation marks without citation.
questions.correct_answer: Include a proper in-text citation and reference entry.
questions.explanation: Slide 35–36 (Unit 11–12 - Citation): Dù đã diễn đạt lại bằng văn phong cá nhân (Paraphrasing), bạn vẫn BẮT BUỘC phải trích dẫn nguồn (in-text citation & reference) để không bị tính là đạo văn.

questions.question: Unlike solicited proposals, an unsolicited proposal requires the writer to:
options: Follow exact RFP formatting instructions provided by the client.
Create a strong persuasive hook to convince the audience that a problem even exists.
Omit financial cost estimates.
Submit directly to regulatory authorities only.
questions.correct_answer: Create a strong persuasive hook to convince the audience that a problem even exists.
questions.explanation: Slide 9 & 12 (Unit 3 & 12 - Unsolicited Proposals): Khác với Solicited (có RFP sẵn), Unsolicited proposal (giống 'cold call') đòi hỏi người viết phải tạo câu mở đầu thuyết phục để chứng minh vấn đề thực sự tồn tại.

questions.question: What is the standard organizational format for listing work experience on a modern résumé?
options: Alphabetical order by company name
Reverse chronological order (most recent first)
Random order based on personal preference
Order of lowest salary to highest salary
questions.correct_answer: Reverse chronological order (most recent first)
questions.explanation: Slide 45 (Unit 13 - Résumé Format): Kinh nghiệm làm việc trên Résumé hiện đại luôn trình bày theo thứ tự ngược thời gian (Reverse chronological order – công việc gần nhất lên đầu).

questions.question: Which item MUST be excluded from a standard professional business résumé?
options: Academic degrees and honors
Personal details such as age, marital status, and photos
Relevant technical competencies
Contact phone number and email
questions.correct_answer: Personal details such as age, marital status, and photos
questions.explanation: Slide 45 (Unit 13 - Résumé Forbidden Content): Chuẩn Résumé quốc tế bắt buộc loại bỏ tuổi tác, tình trạng hôn nhân và ảnh chân dung để tránh phân biệt đối xử.

questions.question: What can happen if a team relies excessively on relationship-building roles while ignoring task roles?
options: Decisions are made too quickly.
Harmony is prioritized at the expense of task progress and deadlines.
Blocking behaviors increase rapidly.
Psychological safety collapses instantly.
questions.correct_answer: Harmony is prioritized at the expense of task progress and deadlines.
questions.explanation: Slide 3 (Unit 1 - Relationship-building Roles): Nếu nhóm quá lạm dụng vai trò giữ hòa khí (Relationship-building) mà bỏ quên thúc đẩy công việc, tiến độ sẽ bị trì trệ và trễ deadline.

questions.question: Which component is essential to include when developing a Team Charter?
options: Individual personal hobbies
Shared team goals, member roles, communication channels, and ground rules
Detailed 10-year career forecasts
Personal financial income histories
questions.correct_answer: Shared team goals, member roles, communication channels, and ground rules
questions.explanation: Slide 4–5 (Unit 2 - Team Charter): Hiến chương nhóm (Team Charter) được lập ngay từ đầu dự án gồm 4 phần cốt lõi: Goals (Mục tiêu), Roles (Vai trò), Channels/Schedule (Kênh & lịch) và Ground Rules (Quy tắc chung).

questions.question: Why is writing an entire business email in CAPITAL LETTERS considered poor netiquette?
options: It uses too much internet bandwidth.
It is equivalent to shouting and makes text hard to read.
It automatically triggers spam filters in all clients.
It deletes recipient attachments automatically.
questions.correct_answer: It is equivalent to shouting and makes text hard to read.
questions.explanation: Slide 7 (Unit 3 - Email Netiquette): Viết toàn bộ email bằng CHỮ IN HOA (ALL CAPS) bị xem là thiếu lịch sự vì tương đương với hành động la hét và rất khó đọc.

questions.question: What is a common organizational symptom of low Emotional Intelligence (EQ) within a team?
options: Increased trust and rapid consensus
Frequent interpersonal friction, missed deadlines, and disengagement
High innovation rates
Improved psychological safety
questions.correct_answer: Frequent interpersonal friction, missed deadlines, and disengagement
questions.explanation: Slide 19 (Unit 4 - Low EQ Symptoms): Hậu quả điển hình của EQ thấp trong nhóm là xung đột cá nhân thường xuyên, trễ deadline, nỗ lực giảm sút và rút lui khỏi nhóm.

questions.question: To prevent unnecessary meetings, what should a manager do first before sending an invitation?
options: Invite every employee in the firm.
Determine if the objective can be resolved via email or a quick memo instead.
Schedule a minimum 2-hour block.
Omit the agenda to keep meetings spontaneous.
questions.correct_answer: Determine if the objective can be resolved via email or a quick memo instead.
questions.explanation: Slide 20 (Unit 5 - Meeting Efficiency): Để tránh họp hành không cần thiết, quản lý cần kiểm tra trước xem vấn đề có thể giải quyết nhanh qua email hoặc memo hay không.

questions.question: Tactical reflection during a tense discussion involves:
options: Agreeing blindly with every point the other person makes.
Mirroring back the speaker's emotional state and key points to show understanding.
Interrupting the speaker to correct factual errors immediately.
Staying silent and walking out of the room.
questions.correct_answer: Mirroring back the speaker's emotional state and key points to show understanding.
questions.explanation: Unit 7 - Chương 24 (Tactical Reflection): Phản chiếu chiến thuật (Tactical reflection) khi tranh luận căng thẳng là nhắc lại cảm xúc và ý chính của người nói để chứng tỏ bạn thực sự hiểu họ.

questions.question: Which element represents the use of "Logos" in a persuasive proposal?
options: Emotional personal anecdotes
Well-structured logical arguments supported by verified statistics and facts
Highlighting the author's executive title
Appealing to moral sympathy
questions.correct_answer: Well-structured logical arguments supported by verified statistics and facts
questions.explanation: Slide 30 (Unit 8 - Logos in Persuasion): Logos là thuyết phục bằng lập luận logic chặt chẽ kết hợp với số liệu thống kê và dẫn chứng đã được kiểm chứng.

questions.question: What is the main objective of an informational business report?
options: To analyze market options and recommend mergers
To present data and factual updates without providing recommendations
To persuade investors to fund a venture
To resolve interpersonal team disputes
questions.correct_answer: To present data and factual updates without providing recommendations
questions.explanation: Slide 37–40 (Unit 12 - Informational Reports): Báo cáo thông tin (Informational report) chỉ trình bày dữ liệu và cập nhật thực tế một cách khách quan, KHÔNG đưa ra khuyến nghị.

questions.question: How does completing an internship primarily benefit a student's career path?
options: It guarantees immediate executive placement.
It provides real-world experience, helps build professional networks, and clarifies career fit.
It replaces the need for a university diploma.
It eliminates all workplace stress.
questions.correct_answer: It provides real-world experience, helps build professional networks, and clarifies career fit.
questions.explanation: Slide 43–45 (Unit 13 - Internship Value): Thực tập giúp sinh viên tích lũy kinh nghiệm thực tế, mở rộng mạng lưới quan hệ và nhận diện công việc nào thực sự phù hợp (loại bỏ lựa chọn không hợp).

title: Đề 4 · Tổng Hợp Toàn Chương Trình
description: 30 câu luyện tập bao phủ toàn bộ 54 slide môn SSG105.

questions.question: When a team faces intense competition from external rival firms, what usually happens to internal cohesion?
options: Internal cohesion decreases.
Internal cohesion increases as members unite against the common challenge.
Interdependence disappears.
Task roles change into blocking roles.
questions.correct_answer: Internal cohesion increases as members unite against the common challenge.
questions.explanation: Slide 2 (Unit 1 - Group Cohesiveness): Cạnh tranh bên ngoài (External competition) là một trong 5 động lực giúp tăng tính gắn kết nội bộ vì các thành viên cùng đoàn kết đối mặt thách thức chung.

questions.question: What defines "Challenger Safety" in a team environment?
options: Freedom to ask basic questions without feeling foolish.
Confidence to question existing methods and suggest innovative alternatives without fear of retaliation.
Willingness to perform assigned tasks without debate.
Being accepted into the group socially.
questions.correct_answer: Confidence to question existing methods and suggest innovative alternatives without fear of retaliation.
questions.explanation: Slide 6 (Unit 2 - Challenger Safety): Challenger Safety là cấp độ cao nhất của an toàn tâm lý: thành viên tự tin phản biện hiện trạng và đề xuất phương án mới mà không sợ bị trù dập.

questions.question: Which standard four fields make up the header block of a formal business memorandum?
options: Dear, Body, Summary, Sincerely
TO, FROM, DATE, SUBJECT
Title, Abstract, Index, Footnote
Greeting, Introduction, Pitch, Signature
questions.correct_answer: TO, FROM, DATE, SUBJECT
questions.explanation: Slide 7–8 (Unit 3 - Business Memo): Phần đầu tiêu chuẩn của một bản ghi nhớ nội bộ (Business Memo) luôn gồm 4 trường: TO, FROM, DATE, SUBJECT.

questions.question: According to Maslow's Hierarchy applied to management, before an employee can be motivated by recognition (esteem), what needs must be satisfied first?
options: Self-actualization needs only
Basic physiological, safety, and social belonging needs
Executive bonus expectations
Advanced leadership training
questions.correct_answer: Basic physiological, safety, and social belonging needs
questions.explanation: Unit 4 - Chương 16 (Maslow's Hierarchy): Theo tháp Maslow trong quản trị, trước khi tạo động lực bằng sự ghi nhận (Esteem), cần thỏa mãn các nhu cầu cơ bản, an toàn và gắn kết xã hội.

questions.question: What is the primary objective of active listening during a team conflict?
options: Formulate a counterargument while the other person speaks.
Fully understand the speaker's perspective and feelings before responding.
Pretend to agree to end the meeting early.
Find grammatical flaws in the speaker's words.
questions.correct_answer: Fully understand the speaker's perspective and feelings before responding.
questions.explanation: Unit 7 (Active Listening): Mục tiêu chính của lắng nghe tích cực khi có xung đột là hiểu trọn vẹn góc nhìn và cảm xúc của người nói trước khi phản hồi.

questions.question: Crossed arms, avoiding eye contact, and leaning away during a proposal pitch generally communicate:
options: High enthusiasm and agreement
Defensive or disengaged attitude
Deep agreement and trust
Executive authority
questions.correct_answer: Defensive or disengaged attitude
questions.explanation: Slide 28 (Unit 8 - Nonverbal Cues): Khoanh tay trước ngực, tránh giao tiếp mắt và ngả người ra sau là tín hiệu phi ngôn ngữ thể hiện thái độ phòng thủ hoặc không hứng thú.

questions.question: Using emotional storytelling to connect with an audience's personal values taps into which rhetorical element?
options: Ethos
Logos
Pathos
Kairos
questions.correct_answer: Pathos
questions.explanation: Slide 30 (Unit 9 - Pathos): Kể chuyện giàu cảm xúc để chạm tới giá trị cá nhân của khán giả là ứng dụng trụ cột Pathos (cảm xúc) trong thuyết phục.

questions.question: Which tone is appropriate for a formal corporate audit report?
options: Casual and humorous
Objective, precise, and professional
Highly emotional and dramatic
Slang-filled and conversational
questions.correct_answer: Objective, precise, and professional
questions.explanation: Slide 34 (Unit 10 - Tone in Writing): Báo cáo kiểm toán doanh nghiệp trang trọng đòi hỏi giọng văn khách quan, chính xác và chuyên nghiệp (Objective, precise, and professional).

questions.question: What is the key difference between a summary and a paraphrase?
options: Summaries are longer than original texts.
A paraphrase rewrites ideas at roughly original length, while a summary significantly condenses key points.
Paraphrases do not require citations.
Summaries use exact direct quotes only.
questions.correct_answer: A paraphrase rewrites ideas at roughly original length, while a summary significantly condenses key points.
questions.explanation: Slide 36 (Unit 12 - Summary vs Paraphrase): Paraphrase diễn đạt lại ý với độ dài tương đương bản gốc, còn Summary tóm tắt cô đọng các ý chính ngắn hơn nhiều (cả hai đều phải trích dẫn).

questions.question: What skill set do top recruiters repeatedly report as most lacking in recent college graduates?
options: Rote memorization
Oral/written communication and teamwork skills
Test-taking speed
Theoretical vocabulary knowledge
questions.correct_answer: Oral/written communication and teamwork skills
questions.explanation: Slide 3 & 43 (Unit 1 & 13 - Career Readiness): Nhà tuyển dụng nhận định kỹ năng sinh viên mới ra trường thiếu hụt nhất là giao tiếp nói/viết và làm việc nhóm (chứ không phải kiến thức chuyên môn đơn thuần).

questions.question: Team members relying on each other's work to complete a project is called:
options: Social loafing
Interdependence
Groupthink
Blocking
questions.correct_answer: Interdependence
questions.explanation: Slide 1–2 (Unit 1 - Interdependence): Sự phụ thuộc lẫn nhau (Interdependence) – các thành viên dựa vào công việc của nhau để hoàn thành mục tiêu chung – là đặc trưng cốt lõi của Team.

questions.question: Inclusion safety means:
options: Members feel safe asking questions.
Members feel accepted and belong to the team.
Members challenge ideas.
Members lead meetings.
questions.correct_answer: Members feel accepted and belong to the team.
questions.explanation: Slide 6 (Unit 2 - Inclusion Safety): Inclusion safety là giai đoạn đầu tiên của an toàn tâm lý: thành viên cảm thấy được chấp nhận và thuộc về tập thể.

questions.question: An RFP stands for:
options: Request for Proposal
Report for Performance
Review for Project
Request for Payment
questions.correct_answer: Request for Proposal
questions.explanation: Slide 9 (Unit 3 - Solicited Proposal): RFP là viết tắt của Request for Proposal (Yêu cầu mời chào đề xuất / Hồ sơ mời thầu).

questions.question: Understanding your own emotions and triggers is part of:
options: Social skills
Self-awareness
Empathy
Self-regulation
questions.correct_answer: Self-awareness
questions.explanation: Slide 19 (Unit 4 - EQ Self-Awareness): Hiểu rõ cảm xúc và điểm kích hoạt (triggers) của chính bản thân mình thuộc năng lực Tự nhận thức (Self-awareness) trong EQ.

questions.question: A meeting agenda should be distributed:
options: During the meeting
In advance of the meeting
After the meeting
Only if requested
questions.correct_answer: In advance of the meeting
questions.explanation: Slide 20 (Unit 5 - Meeting Agenda): Chương trình cuộc họp (Agenda) phải được gửi trước cuộc họp (in advance) để mọi người chuẩn bị nội dung.

questions.question: Complex emotional sensitive discussions should avoid using:
options: Face-to-face meetings
Text messaging / Chat
Video conferences
In-person retreats
questions.correct_answer: Text messaging / Chat
questions.explanation: Slide 20 (Unit 6 - Communication Channels): Các cuộc thảo luận phức tạp, nhạy cảm về cảm xúc cần tránh dùng tin nhắn văn bản/chat (vì dễ hiểu lầm sắc thái), nên gặp trực tiếp hoặc gọi video.

questions.question: Finding the fundamental reason behind a problem is identifying the:
options: Symptom
Root cause
Alternative
Criteria
questions.correct_answer: Root cause
questions.explanation: Unit 7 (Root Cause Analysis): Tìm ra nguyên nhân gốc rễ đứng sau một sự cố gọi là xác định Root cause (khác với triệu chứng bề mặt - Symptom).

questions.question: High visual contrast in slide design means:
options: Light gray text on white background
Dark text on light background or vice versa
Yellow text on light green background
Mixing 10 colors together
questions.correct_answer: Dark text on light background or vice versa
questions.explanation: Slide 54 (Unit 8 - Visual Contrast): Độ tương phản cao (High visual contrast) trên slide nghĩa là dùng chữ tối trên nền sáng (hoặc chữ sáng trên nền tối) để dễ đọc từ xa.

questions.question: The first component of a 60-second elevator speech is:
options: Action request
Attention statement / hook
Detailed background
Salary expectation
questions.correct_answer: Attention statement / hook
questions.explanation: Slide 30 (Unit 9 - Elevator Speech Structure): Cấu trúc 5 phần của Elevator Speech bắt đầu bằng Attention statement / hook (câu thu hút sự chú ý) -> Intro -> Body -> Conclusion -> Call to Action.

questions.question: Which sentence uses active voice effectively?
options: The report was written by the team.
The team wrote the report.
Mistakes were made by us.
Directives were issued.
questions.correct_answer: The team wrote the report.
questions.explanation: Slide 34 (Unit 10 - Active Voice): Câu chủ động ('The team wrote the report') trực diện, rõ người thực hiện và mạnh mẽ hơn câu bị động ('was written by...').

questions.question: Which source is generally most credible for business research?
options: Anonymous personal blog
Peer-reviewed journal / official industry report
Unverified social media post
Forum comment thread
questions.correct_answer: Peer-reviewed journal / official industry report
questions.explanation: Slide 35 (Unit 11 - Research Credibility): Nguồn đáng tin cậy nhất cho nghiên cứu kinh doanh là tạp chí khoa học bình duyệt (peer-reviewed journal) hoặc báo cáo ngành chính thức.

questions.question: An Executive Summary in a long report is placed:
options: At the very end after appendices
At the beginning of the report
In the middle body paragraph
Only on a website link
questions.correct_answer: At the beginning of the report
questions.explanation: Slide 37–40 (Unit 12 - Executive Summary): Phần tóm tắt điều hành (Executive Summary) luôn được đặt ở ngay đầu báo cáo dài để lãnh đạo nắm ý chính nhanh chóng.

questions.question: Resume accomplishment statements should begin with:
options: Weak passive phrases ("I was responsible for...")
Strong action verbs ("Engineered", "Managed", "Increased")
Personal pronouns ("I think I did...")
Complex legal terms
questions.correct_answer: Strong action verbs ("Engineered", "Managed", "Increased")
questions.explanation: Slide 45 (Unit 13 - Résumé Action Verbs): Các gạch đầu dòng mô tả thành tích trong Résumé phải bắt đầu bằng động từ hành động mạnh (như Engineered, Managed, Increased), KHÔNG dùng 'I' hay bị động.

questions.question: "Social loafing" refers to:
options: Working extra hours in a group
Exerting less effort when working in a group than individually
Leading a meeting smoothly
Helping teammates voluntarily
questions.correct_answer: Exerting less effort when working in a group than individually
questions.explanation: Slide 2 (Unit 1 - Social Loafing): 'Social loafing' (ỷ lại xã hội) là hiện tượng cá nhân bỏ ra ít nỗ lực hơn khi làm việc nhóm so với khi làm một mình.

questions.question: In the Trust Equation, Credibility relates to:
options: How reliable your actions are over time
Your expertise, reputation, and truthfulness
How safe people feel sharing secrets
How selfish you appear
questions.correct_answer: Your expertise, reputation, and truthfulness
questions.explanation: Slide 5 (Unit 2 - Trust Equation): Trong công thức niềm tin, Credibility (Độ tin cậy chuyên môn) gắn liền với năng lực, uy tín và sự trung thực của bạn.

questions.question: Shifting to a leadership mindset means moving focus from:
options: People to tasks only
Individual technical execution to enabling others and managing relationships
Long-term goals to immediate panic
Self-reflection to blame
questions.correct_answer: Individual technical execution to enabling others and managing relationships
questions.explanation: Slide 13 (Unit 4 - Leadership Mindset Shift): Chuyển sang tư duy lãnh đạo nghĩa là chuyển trọng tâm từ tự làm chuyên môn sang hỗ trợ người khác và quản trị mối quan hệ.

questions.question: When offering constructive feedback, focus on:
options: The person's permanent personality traits
Specific observable behaviors and future solutions
Personal insults
Past mistakes from years ago
questions.correct_answer: Specific observable behaviors and future solutions
questions.explanation: Unit 7 - Chương 24 (Constructive Criticism): Khi góp ý mang tính xây dựng, hãy tập trung vào hành vi cụ thể có thể quan sát được và giải pháp tương lai, tránh công kích tính cách.

questions.question: Standing upright with open gestures during a talk projects:
options: Arrogance and hostility
Confidence and open authority
Extreme nervousness
Boredom
questions.correct_answer: Confidence and open authority
questions.explanation: Slide 28 (Unit 8 - Speaker Posture): Đứng thẳng và dùng cử chỉ tay cởi mở khi thuyết trình truyền tải sự tự tin và uy tín tự nhiên của diễn giả.

questions.question: Using excessive internal company jargon with external clients leads to:
options: Instant clarity
Confusion and miscommunication
High sales automatically
Legal security
questions.correct_answer: Confusion and miscommunication
questions.explanation: Slide 34 (Unit 10 - Jargon Usage): Lạm dụng thuật ngữ nội bộ (jargon) với khách hàng bên ngoài sẽ gây nhầm lẫn và hiểu sai thông điệp.

questions.question: A "Career" is best described as:
options: A short-term task to earn immediate cash
A long-term professional journey of growth and skill building
A temporary summer gig
An entry-level task only
questions.correct_answer: A long-term professional journey of growth and skill building
questions.explanation: Slide 43 (Unit 13 - Job vs Career): 'Job' là công việc ngắn hạn để kiếm tiền, còn 'Career' là hành trình phát triển nghề nghiệp và bồi đắp kỹ năng dài hạn.

title: Đề 5 · Giao Tiếp, Thuyết Phục & Nghề Nghiệp
description: 30 câu chuyên sâu về Team Roles, Business Writing, EQ, Proposals và Résumé.

questions.question: When does "Groupthink" typically occur in a team?
options: Members prioritize consensus over critical evaluation.
Members encourage diverse opinions and constructive debate.
A team uses quantitative data to evaluate alternatives.
The leader delegates operational tasks to sub-teams.
questions.correct_answer: Members prioritize consensus over critical evaluation.
questions.explanation: Groupthink xảy ra khi các thành viên ưu tiên sự đồng thuận bề mặt hơn việc đánh giá phản biện.

questions.question: In the Trust Equation, what does "Reliability" refer to?
options: Possessing technical credentials and university degrees.
Focusing purely on one's own personal goals.
Sharing personal hobbies with coworkers.
Keeping promises and delivering consistent quality over time.
questions.correct_answer: Keeping promises and delivering consistent quality over time.
questions.explanation: Reliability là giữ lời hứa và duy trì chất lượng công việc ổn định theo thời gian.

questions.question: What does "Contributor Safety" allow team members to do?
options: Avoid doing assigned work without consequences.
Work completely isolated from the rest of the team.
Apply their skills to make meaningful contributions safely.
Challenge the CEO publicly without preparation.
questions.correct_answer: Apply their skills to make meaningful contributions safely.
questions.explanation: Contributor Safety là giai đoạn thành viên tự tin đóng góp kỹ năng và ý tưởng cá nhân.

questions.question: Within what timeframe should professional business emails ideally be answered?
options: Within 10 business days.
Within 24 hours during business days.
Within 5 minutes regardless of the hour.
Once a week on Friday afternoons.
questions.correct_answer: Within 24 hours during business days.
questions.explanation: Email công việc chuẩn mực nên được phản hồi trong vòng 24 giờ trong ngày làm việc.

questions.question: What is included in a standard business letter signature block?
options: Writer's typed name, title, and handwritten signature.
Writer's age, photo, and marital status.
Only the recipient's mailing address.
A casual emoji and personal phone number.
questions.correct_answer: Writer's typed name, title, and handwritten signature.
questions.explanation: Phần chữ ký (signature block) của Business Letter gồm tên đánh máy, chức danh và chữ ký tay.

questions.question: What does virtual leadership rely on most heavily to succeed?
options: Monitoring employees' webcams continuously.
Holding mandatory 3-hour daily meetings.
Requiring face-to-face lunches every week.
Clear communication, trust, and clear outcome metrics.
questions.correct_answer: Clear communication, trust, and clear outcome metrics.
questions.explanation: Lãnh đạo từ xa (Virtual Leadership) chuyển trọng tâm từ sự hiện diện sang kết quả (outcomes), niềm tin và giao tiếp rõ ràng.

questions.question: How do managers with low Emotional Intelligence (EQ) typically react to constructive feedback?
options: By asking clarifying open-ended questions.
By separating validation from agreement.
By becoming defensive or blaming others.
By listening actively and thanking the speaker.
questions.correct_answer: By becoming defensive or blaming others.
questions.explanation: Người có EQ thấp thường phản ứng phòng thủ (defensive) hoặc đổ lỗi khi nhận góp ý.

questions.question: What essential elements must a well-prepared meeting agenda include?
options: Private salary details of all team members.
Purpose, topics, time allocations, and responsible owners.
Personal opinions about attendees' past mistakes.
Full verbatim transcripts of previous meetings.
questions.correct_answer: Purpose, topics, time allocations, and responsible owners.
questions.explanation: Agenda cuộc họp cần nêu rõ mục đích, nội dung, thời lượng phân bổ và người phụ trách.

questions.question: What is the #1 rule during the idea generation phase of brainstorming?
options: Defer judgment and welcome wild ideas.
Critique every flawed idea immediately.
Allow only the team leader to propose solutions.
Vote on the very first idea suggested.
questions.correct_answer: Defer judgment and welcome wild ideas.
questions.explanation: Quy tắc số 1 của Brainstorming là tạm hoãn phán xét (suspend/defer judgment) và khuyến khích số lượng ý tưởng.

questions.question: In persuasive speaking, what does "Ethos" refer to?
options: Emotional storytelling that evokes sympathy.
Statistical charts and cause-effect logic.
Speaking rapidly to fit more words in.
Speaker credibility, character, and trustworthiness.
questions.correct_answer: Speaker credibility, character, and trustworthiness.
questions.explanation: Ethos là uy tín, nhân cách và độ tin cậy của người nói.

questions.question: Which practice directly improves presentation slide readability?
options: Using five or more decorative font families.
Using light yellow text on a white background.
Using a minimum 24pt body font and strong color contrast.
Putting full paragraphs of text on every slide.
questions.correct_answer: Using a minimum 24pt body font and strong color contrast.
questions.explanation: Slide thuyết trình dễ đọc khi cỡ chữ tối thiểu 24pt và độ tương phản màu sắc cao.

questions.question: What is the standard length of an effective elevator speech?
options: 30 minutes with a full slide deck.
30 to 60 seconds (~100 words).
10 to 15 minutes (~1500 words).
3 to 5 seconds (1 sentence).
questions.correct_answer: 30 to 60 seconds (~100 words).
questions.explanation: Elevator Speech chuẩn kéo dài 30–60 giây (khoảng 100 từ) và gồm 5 phần.

questions.question: Which sentence is an example of overly abstract business wording?
options: "We will enhance operational parameters."
"We will cut server reboot time by 3 minutes."
"Our Q3 revenue increased by 18%."
"We hired 4 backend engineers in October."
questions.correct_answer: "We will enhance operational parameters."
questions.explanation: "Enhance operational parameters" là cách diễn đạt trừu tượng, mơ hồ thay vì nêu con số cụ thể.

questions.question: Which sentence best demonstrates concrete, specific business writing?
options: "We will make our tech stuff much better soon."
"Our team is working really hard on quality."
"Performance improved significantly recently."
"We will cut server reboot time by 3 minutes."
questions.correct_answer: "We will cut server reboot time by 3 minutes."
questions.explanation: Ngôn ngữ cụ thể (Concrete) sử dụng số liệu, thời gian hoặc hành động đo lường được.

questions.question: What is strictly required when paraphrasing a source in a report?
options: Omitting the citation because the words changed.
Shortening a 10-page paper to 2 sentences without credit.
Restating the original idea in your own words with proper citation.
Keeping the exact wording without quotation marks.
questions.correct_answer: Restating the original idea in your own words with proper citation.
questions.explanation: Paraphrase là diễn đạt lại bằng ngôn từ của mình với độ dài tương đương và BẮT BUỘC phải trích dẫn nguồn.

questions.question: What distinguishes an analytical report from an informational report?
options: Being written solely as an informal chat message.
Data analysis, conclusions, and actionable recommendations.
Presenting raw unanalyzed tables only.
Omitting headings and executive summaries.
questions.correct_answer: Data analysis, conclusions, and actionable recommendations.
questions.explanation: Analytical Report phân tích dữ liệu để đưa ra kết luận và khuyến nghị hành động.

questions.question: What does a "Compare-contrast" report layout do?
options: Evaluates similarities and differences between two or more options.
Lists events strictly in the order they occurred over time.
Explains the history of the company since its founding.
Summarizes only one side of an argument without alternatives.
questions.correct_answer: Evaluates similarities and differences between two or more options.
questions.explanation: Mẫu Compare-contrast dùng để so sánh điểm giống và khác nhau giữa các phương án.

questions.question: Which document is a classic example of an informational report?
options: A strategic recommendation on whether to merge two firms.
A persuasive pitch requesting investor funding.
A root-cause failure analysis with policy changes.
A monthly sales status update table.
questions.correct_answer: A monthly sales status update table.
questions.explanation: Báo cáo thông tin (Informational Report) chỉ trình bày dữ liệu/tình hình thực tế mà không đưa ra khuyến nghị.

questions.question: What triggers a "Solicited Proposal"?
options: An internal team conflict over meeting times.
A casual conversation in a hallway.
An official Request for Proposal (RFP) from a client.
A seller sending an unrequested pitch like a cold call.
questions.correct_answer: An official Request for Proposal (RFP) from a client.
questions.explanation: Solicited Proposal được viết để đáp lại lời mời thầu / yêu cầu chính thức (RFP) từ khách hàng.

questions.question: What triggers an "Unsolicited Proposal"?
options: A signed warranty contract.
A proactive pitch sent without a prior client request.
A formal government RFP announcement.
A mandatory quarterly audit checklist.
questions.correct_answer: A proactive pitch sent without a prior client request.
questions.explanation: Unsolicited Proposal là đề xuất chủ động gửi đi khi khách hàng chưa đưa ra yêu cầu mời thầu.

questions.question: What is the recommended length for a standard professional résumé?
options: 1 to 2 pages maximum.
5 to 7 pages with full transcripts.
Half a page without contact details.
At least 4 pages for recent graduates.
questions.correct_answer: 1 to 2 pages maximum.
questions.explanation: Độ dài tiêu chuẩn của một bản Résumé chuyên nghiệp là 1–2 trang.

questions.question: Why should headshot photos be excluded from standard international business résumés?
options: Because printers cannot print images.
Because photos make files smaller than 1KB.
Because companies do not hire people with photos.
To prevent unconscious bias and discrimination.
questions.correct_answer: To prevent unconscious bias and discrimination.
questions.explanation: Tiêu chuẩn Résumé quốc tế cấm chèn ảnh chân dung, tuổi tác, tình trạng hôn nhân để tránh thiên kiến/phân biệt đối xử.

questions.question: Which behavior exemplifies a task-facilitating role in a team?
options: Focusing exclusively on jokes to avoid work.
Refusing to share necessary project files.
Summarizing progress and asking clarifying questions.
Dismissing teammates' ideas without rationale.
questions.correct_answer: Summarizing progress and asking clarifying questions.
