questions.explanation: Vai trò thúc đẩy công việc (Task-facilitating) gồm tổng hợp tiến độ, cung cấp/hỏi thông tin để nhóm hoàn thành mục tiêu.

questions.question: Which behavior exemplifies a blocking role in a team?
options: Asking open-ended coaching questions.
Interrupting, rejecting ideas without rationale, and nitpicking.
Mediating conflicts calmly between members.
Tracking action items and upcoming deadlines.
questions.correct_answer: Interrupting, rejecting ideas without rationale, and nitpicking.
questions.explanation: Blocking roles cản trở tiến độ và phá vỡ sự đồng thuận bằng cách ngắt lời, bác bỏ vô lý hoặc soi mói.

questions.question: What is considered the primary goal of university classroom team projects?
options: Developing real-world teamwork skills and the learning experience.
Producing a commercial product to sell immediately.
Letting one student do all the work for a fast grade.
Avoiding communication with classmates.
questions.correct_answer: Developing real-world teamwork skills and the learning experience.
questions.explanation: Ở các dự án nhóm đại học, trải nghiệm học tập và rèn kỹ năng làm việc nhóm quan trọng hơn sản phẩm cuối cùng.

questions.question: Which action is a core element of active listening?
options: Preparing your rebuttal while the speaker is talking.
Checking your phone while nodding mechanically.
Interrupting to change the subject immediately.
Paraphrasing the speaker's points to verify understanding.
questions.correct_answer: Paraphrasing the speaker's points to verify understanding.
questions.explanation: Active listening đòi hỏi lắng nghe trọn vẹn và diễn đạt lại ý người nói để xác nhận đã hiểu đúng.

questions.question: Which structure correctly represents an "I" statement in conflict resolution?
options: "Everyone thinks you are being lazy."
"Why can't you ever listen properly?"
"I feel [emotion] when [behavior] because [impact]."
"You always ruin our team deadlines."
questions.correct_answer: "I feel [emotion] when [behavior] because [impact]."
questions.explanation: Câu cấu trúc "I" nêu cảm xúc, hành vi cụ thể và tác động khách quan mà không công kích cá nhân.

questions.question: Which needs form the most basic foundation of Maslow's Hierarchy?
options: Leadership coaching and autonomy.
Physiological needs (food, shelter, basic pay).
Self-actualization and creative fulfillment.
Public recognition and prestigious awards.
questions.correct_answer: Physiological needs (food, shelter, basic pay).
questions.explanation: Tầng thấp nhất của tháp Maslow là nhu cầu sinh lý/cơ bản (Physiological needs).

questions.question: What does sustained, natural eye contact during a presentation convey?
options: Honesty, confidence, and audience engagement.
Hostility and lack of preparation.
Deception and anxiety.
Disinterest in the topic.
questions.correct_answer: Honesty, confidence, and audience engagement.
questions.explanation: Giao tiếp bằng mắt tự nhiên thể hiện sự tự tin, trung thực và kết nối với khán giả.

questions.question: What is the key benefit of career exploration and internships for students?
options: Guaranteeing an immediate CEO position upon graduation.
Replacing the need for soft skills entirely.
Eliminating all future workplace challenges.
Helping identify personal strengths, values, and eliminating poor career fits.
questions.correct_answer: Helping identify personal strengths, values, and eliminating poor career fits.
questions.explanation: Khám phá nghề nghiệp và thực tập giúp nhận diện thế mạnh và loại bỏ những công việc không phù hợp.

title: Đề 6 · Thực Chiến Teamwork, Văn Bản & Thuyết Trình
description: 30 câu mới hoàn toàn phủ đủ 13 Unit (Slide 1–54) theo chuẩn cấu trúc đề thi thật FE SSG105.

questions.question: Which of the following is one of the 5 core characteristics of a true team?
options: Evaluation is based strictly on individual output without interaction.
Members rotate out randomly every 48 hours.
Shared accountability among members for collective outcomes.
Members work toward purely independent personal goals.
questions.correct_answer: Shared accountability among members for collective outcomes.
questions.explanation: Slide 1–3 (Unit 1): 5 đặc điểm cốt lõi của Team gồm: Shared accountability, Interdependence, Stability over time, Authority & Decision-making power, Social context.

questions.question: According to workplace studies cited in SSG105, what is the primary reason roughly 60% of managers fail?
options: Over-investing in employee training programs.
Lack of teamwork and interpersonal skills.
Lack of technical or domain expertise.
Insufficient office software licenses.
questions.correct_answer: Lack of teamwork and interpersonal skills.
questions.explanation: Slide 1–3 (Unit 1): 60% quản lý thất bại do thiếu kỹ năng làm việc nhóm và giao tiếp, trong khi chỉ 9% thất bại do thiếu chuyên môn kỹ thuật.

questions.question: Which cohesiveness driver strengthens team pride when membership is perceived as selective or hard to obtain?
options: Exclusiveness.
Large team size.
Internal role conflict.
Geographic dispersion.
questions.correct_answer: Exclusiveness.
questions.explanation: Slide 2 (Unit 1): Trong 5 động lực gắn kết (Size, Similarity, Success, Exclusiveness, Competition), Exclusiveness (tính chọn lọc/độc quyền) làm tăng niềm tự hào của thành viên.

questions.question: When should a Team Charter ideally be created by a project group?
options: Right after the final presentation defense.
Only when a severe conflict forces the team to stop working.
During the last week before submission.
At the very beginning of the project during launch.
questions.correct_answer: At the very beginning of the project during launch.
questions.explanation: Slide 4 (Unit 2): Team Charter (Hiến chương nhóm) phải được thiết lập ngay từ đầu dự án để thống nhất mục tiêu, vai trò, kênh giao tiếp và quy tắc chung.

questions.question: In the Trust Equation, what does 'Intimacy' measure?
options: Your academic GPA and professional certifications.
How often you boast about your achievements.
The safety and discretion people feel when sharing candid thoughts with you.
How fast you reply to technical emails.
questions.correct_answer: The safety and discretion people feel when sharing candid thoughts with you.
questions.explanation: Slide 5 (Unit 2): Intimacy (Sự gần gũi/an toàn chia sẻ) đo mức độ an tâm và bảo mật khi người khác chia sẻ thông tin thẳng thắn với bạn.

questions.question: A new intern feels welcomed by teammates and invited to team lunches without feeling excluded. Which stage of psychological safety is this?
options: Learner safety.
Inclusion safety.
Challenger safety.
Contributor safety.
questions.correct_answer: Inclusion safety.
questions.explanation: Slide 6 (Unit 2): Inclusion safety là giai đoạn đầu tiên, giúp thành viên cảm thấy được chấp nhận và thuộc về nhóm.

questions.question: What should a sender do before attaching a very large file (e.g., 50MB video) to a business email?
options: Notify the recipient in advance or share a cloud link instead.
Send the file in 50 separate emails without explanation.
Write the entire email subject line in ALL CAPS.
Omit the body text and attach only the file.
questions.correct_answer: Notify the recipient in advance or share a cloud link instead.
questions.explanation: Slide 7 (Unit 3): Quy tắc Email chuyên nghiệp: phải báo trước nếu gửi file dung lượng lớn (hoặc dùng link chia sẻ) và không dùng ALL CAPS.

questions.question: How many zones and standard components typically make up a formal business letter?
options: 2 zones and 4 components.
10 zones and 30 components.
1 zone and 3 components.
5 zones and 15 components.
questions.correct_answer: 5 zones and 15 components.
questions.explanation: Slide 8 (Unit 3): Thư thương mại (Business Letter) gửi ra bên ngoài có cấu trúc chuẩn gồm 5 vùng, 15 thành phần (khác với Memo nội bộ chỉ có 4 trường header).

questions.question: Why is an unsolicited business proposal often compared to a 'cold call'?
options: Because it contains no pricing or schedule.
Because it is always rejected by law.
Because the recipient did not request it and must first be convinced a need exists.
Because it must be delivered exclusively by telephone.
questions.correct_answer: Because the recipient did not request it and must first be convinced a need exists.
questions.explanation: Slide 9 (Unit 3): Unsolicited proposal (đề xuất chủ động) giống như 'cold call' vì khách hàng chưa từng yêu cầu (không có RFP), người viết phải tự thuyết phục họ về vấn đề.

questions.question: Which sentence best demonstrates objective, concise business writing?
options: 'Ticket resolution parameters were optimistically enhanced somewhat.'
'Customer support ticket resolution time dropped by 22% in Q2.'
'We totally crushed our support goals and everyone is super hyped!'
'Support stuff was handled way faster by our amazing folks lately.'
questions.correct_answer: 'Customer support ticket resolution time dropped by 22% in Q2.'
questions.explanation: Slide 34 (Unit 10): Văn phong kinh doanh chuẩn mực sử dụng ngôn ngữ khách quan, chính xác và số liệu cụ thể (Concrete terms).

questions.question: Which online source requires the highest level of skepticism and verification before citing in a business report?
options: An anonymous blog post with no cited data or author credentials.
A government census statistical database.
A peer-reviewed university research journal.
An audited annual corporate financial filing.
questions.correct_answer: An anonymous blog post with no cited data or author credentials.
questions.explanation: Slide 35 (Unit 11): Bài blog ẩn danh không có nguồn dữ liệu kiểm chứng là nguồn kém tin cậy nhất, dễ gây sai lệch thông tin.

questions.question: What is the key characteristic of a 'Summary' compared to the original text?
options: It keeps the exact same length as the original passage.
It copies every sentence verbatim without quotation marks.
It does not require citing the original author.
It is significantly shorter and captures only the main ideas with proper citation.
questions.correct_answer: It is significantly shorter and captures only the main ideas with proper citation.
questions.explanation: Slide 36 (Unit 12): Summary tóm tắt các ý chính ngắn gọn hơn nhiều so với bản gốc (khác với Paraphrase có độ dài tương đương), và vẫn BẮT BUỘC phải trích dẫn nguồn.

questions.question: A manager asks you to evaluate three CRM vendors and recommend which one the company should buy. Which report type is required?
options: Attendance log.
Descriptive memo.
Analytical report.
Informational report.
questions.correct_answer: Analytical report.
questions.explanation: Slide 37–40 (Unit 12): Khi đề bài yêu cầu đánh giá các phương án và ĐƯA RA KHUYẾN NGHỊ (recommend), đó chắc chắn là Analytical report.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of a mid-project progress report?
options: To criticize teammates personally for past mistakes.
To update stakeholders on completed work, current status, and upcoming risks or plans.
To hide schedule delays until the final deadline.
To replace the final product delivery.
questions.correct_answer: To update stakeholders on completed work, current status, and upcoming risks or plans.
questions.explanation: Slide 38–39 (Unit 12): Báo cáo tiến độ giúp các bên liên quan nắm được phần việc đã xong, tình trạng hiện tại, rủi ro và kế hoạch tiếp theo (tránh che giấu vấn đề).

questions.question: What key mindset shift is required when an engineer transitions into a team leader role?
options: Moving from executing individual technical work to enabling people and managing stakeholders.
Doing 100% of the coding alone so teammates have nothing to do.
Avoiding all communication with other departments.
Micromanaging every keystroke of junior staff.
questions.correct_answer: Moving from executing individual technical work to enabling people and managing stakeholders.
questions.explanation: Slide 13 (Unit 4): Tư duy lãnh đạo đòi hỏi chuyển từ làm chuyên môn cá nhân sang quản trị mối quan hệ con người và các bên liên quan (Stakeholders).

questions.question: According to Maslow, once an employee's basic pay and job security are stable, which need becomes a stronger motivator?
options: Basic food and water survival.
Physical shelter from weather.
Punishment avoidance.
Social belonging and positive team relationships.
questions.correct_answer: Social belonging and positive team relationships.
questions.explanation: Unit 4 - Chương 16: Khi nhu cầu sinh lý và an toàn (Physiological & Safety) đã được đáp ứng, con người hướng tới nhu cầu kết nối xã hội (Belonging).

questions.question: Who should be invited to a synchronous project decision meeting?
options: Only the team leader speaking to an empty room.
Random people who have free time on their calendar.
Only the key participants whose input or decision authority is directly needed.
Every employee in the entire company regardless of role.
questions.correct_answer: Only the key participants whose input or decision authority is directly needed.
questions.explanation: Slide 20 (Unit 5–6): Quy tắc quản lý cuộc họp: KHÔNG mời những người không liên quan để tránh lãng phí thời gian.

questions.question: Which statement is appropriate to include in official Meeting Minutes?
options: 'Everyone felt bored during the second half of the call.'
'The team agreed to launch Beta testing on May 12, led by Lan.'
'Nam looked very annoyed and complained unfairly about the budget.'
'Minh's design idea was obviously terrible compared to Hoa's.'
questions.correct_answer: 'The team agreed to launch Beta testing on May 12, led by Lan.'
questions.explanation: Slide 20 (Unit 6): Biên bản cuộc họp (Meeting Minutes) phải khách quan, ghi nhận quyết định và người phụ trách, tuyệt đối KHÔNG chứa cảm xúc hay nhận xét cá nhân.

questions.question: After generating possible solutions in brainstorming, what should a team do next before choosing one?
options: Establish clear criteria and evaluate each option against those criteria.
Immediately implement the loudest member's favorite idea.
Skip evaluation to save five minutes.
Redefine a completely unrelated problem.
questions.correct_answer: Establish clear criteria and evaluate each option against those criteria.
questions.explanation: Unit 7 - Chương 21–22: Sau khi tạo danh sách giải pháp, cần thiết lập tiêu chí (criteria) để đánh giá và lựa chọn phương án tối ưu.

questions.question: What is the healthiest way to respond when receiving constructive criticism from a teammate?
options: Interrupt immediately and accuse them of personal bias.
Say 'I'm fine, do whatever you want' and stop contributing.
Bring up an unrelated mistake they made last month.
Listen carefully, ask clarifying questions, and focus on how to improve the work.
questions.correct_answer: Listen carefully, ask clarifying questions, and focus on how to improve the work.
questions.explanation: Unit 7 - Chương 24: Tiếp nhận phản hồi hiệu quả đòi hỏi kiểm soát cảm xúc, không vơ vào cá nhân và đặt câu hỏi làm rõ để cải thiện.

questions.question: What does 'separating validation from agreement' mean during a disagreement?
options: Ignoring the other person's feelings completely.
Refusing to speak until the other person apologizes.
Acknowledging that the other person's concern makes sense without having to abandon your own stance.
Forcing yourself to agree with everything the other person says.
questions.correct_answer: Acknowledging that the other person's concern makes sense without having to abandon your own stance.
questions.explanation: Unit 7 - Chương 24: Validation (thừa nhận góc nhìn/cảm xúc của họ là hợp lý) khác với Agreement (đồng ý hoàn toàn về giải pháp).

questions.question: Which behavior is a direct consequence of low Emotional Intelligence (EQ) in a group project?
options: Stronger mutual trust among teammates.
Missed deadlines, reduced effort, and emotional withdrawal from the team.
Higher psychological safety and faster conflict resolution.
Transparent communication of schedule risks.
questions.correct_answer: Missed deadlines, reduced effort, and emotional withdrawal from the team.
questions.explanation: Slide 19 (Unit 4–5): Hậu quả của EQ thấp là trễ deadline, nỗ lực giảm sút và rút lui khỏi hoạt động nhóm.

questions.question: A presenter shares a moving personal story about a patient helped by a new medical device. Which Aristotelian appeal is this?
options: Pathos.
Logos.
Ethos.
Syntax.
questions.correct_answer: Pathos.
questions.explanation: Slide 30 (Unit 8–9): Kể câu chuyện chạm đến cảm xúc và sự đồng cảm của khán giả thuộc trụ cột Pathos.

questions.question: Why should you limit the number of font families on a presentation slide deck to at most two?
options: Because presentation software crashes with three fonts.
Because each slide must contain 500 words.
To make text harder to read from the back row.
To maintain visual consistency and avoid distracting the audience.
questions.correct_answer: To maintain visual consistency and avoid distracting the audience.
questions.explanation: Slide 54 (Unit 8): Dùng tối đa 2 font chữ giúp slide đồng bộ, sạch sẽ và dễ theo dõi.

questions.question: Which nonverbal habit weakens a speaker's credibility during a Q&A session?
options: Nodding attentively and pausing before answering.
Standing upright with open hand gestures.
Sighing loudly, rolling eyes, or checking a wristwatch while someone asks a question.
Maintaining steady, natural eye contact with the questioner.
questions.correct_answer: Sighing loudly, rolling eyes, or checking a wristwatch while someone asks a question.
questions.explanation: Slide 28 (Unit 8): Giao tiếp phi ngôn ngữ tiêu cực như đảo mắt, thở dài là điều tối kỵ và không thể thu hồi (irreversible).

questions.question: What is the final component of a 5-part Elevator Speech?
options: Personal medical history.
Residual Message (Call to Action).
Attention Statement.
Detailed financial appendix.
questions.correct_answer: Residual Message (Call to Action).
questions.explanation: Slide 30 (Unit 9): Cấu trúc 5 phần của Elevator Speech: Attention Statement -> Intro -> Body -> Conclusion -> Residual Message (Call to Action).

questions.question: Why do universities encourage students to take internships before graduation?
options: To gain real-world exposure and eliminate career paths that do not fit them.
To guarantee they never have to write a résumé.
To replace all university coursework.
To earn executive salaries immediately.
questions.correct_answer: To gain real-world exposure and eliminate career paths that do not fit them.
questions.explanation: Slide 43 (Unit 13): Thực tập giúp sinh viên trải nghiệm thực tế và sớm loại bỏ những công việc không phù hợp với bản thân.

questions.question: Which pronoun rule applies to bullet points on a professional résumé?
options: Start every bullet point with 'I was responsible for...'
Use passive voice throughout the entire document.
Write in casual text-message slang.
Avoid first-person pronouns like 'I' or 'Me' and start with strong action verbs.
questions.correct_answer: Avoid first-person pronouns like 'I' or 'Me' and start with strong action verbs.
questions.explanation: Slide 45 (Unit 13): Résumé chuẩn CẤM dùng đại từ nhân xưng 'I/Me' và câu bị động; phải bắt đầu bằng động từ hành động mạnh.

questions.question: Which item MUST NOT appear on a standard international résumé?
options: Relevant technical skills and tools.
Professional email address.
Marital status and expected monthly salary.
University degree and graduation year.
questions.correct_answer: Marital status and expected monthly salary.
questions.explanation: Slide 45 (Unit 13): Résumé chuẩn quốc tế cấm ghi tuổi, tình trạng hôn nhân, ảnh chân dung và mức lương mong muốn.

questions.question: What framework is recommended for structuring accomplishment stories in a Cover Letter?
options: ALL CAPS.
STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result).
SWOT only.
FIFO (First-In, First-Out).
questions.correct_answer: STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result).
questions.explanation: Slide 46 (Unit 13): Cover Letter nên kể câu chuyện kết nối 2–3 trải nghiệm nổi bật theo mô hình STAR (Situation - Task - Action - Result).

title: Đề 7 · Lãnh Đạo, EQ, Báo Cáo & Hồ Sơ Nghề Nghiệp
description: 30 câu mới hoàn toàn kiểm tra tình huống thực tế và lý thuyết trọng tâm Slide 1–54.

questions.question: Which company case study in SSG105 achieved a 40% productivity increase through effective teamwork?
options: An organization that banned collaboration.
General Mills.
A local single-person bakery.
A company with zero team meetings.
questions.correct_answer: General Mills.
questions.explanation: Slide 1–3 (Unit 1): Số liệu nổi bật trong bài giảng: Xerox tăng 30% năng suất, General Mills tăng 40% năng suất, FedEx giảm 13% lỗi.

questions.question: Roughly what percentage of team projects fail to meet their goals according to organizational research?
questions.explanation: Slide 1–3 (Unit 1): Tỷ lệ thất bại của các dự án nhóm dao động từ 50% đến 70% nếu thiếu kỹ năng phối hợp.

questions.question: A member focuses heavily on keeping everyone happy and avoiding any debate, causing the team to miss deadlines. What happened?
options: Excessive task-facilitating roles caused conflict.
The team had too much challenger safety.
The Team Charter was too short.
Overuse of relationship-building roles slowed down decision-making.
questions.correct_answer: Overuse of relationship-building roles slowed down decision-making.
questions.explanation: Slide 3 (Unit 1): Lạm dụng quá mức vai trò xây dựng quan hệ (Relationship-building) sẽ làm chậm quá trình ra quyết định.

questions.question: Which set lists the 4 core components of a Team Charter?
options: Logos, Pathos, Ethos, and Kairos.
Memo, Letter, Email, and Chat.
Goals, Roles, Schedule/Channels, and Ground Rules.
Salary, Photos, Age, and Marital Status.
questions.correct_answer: Goals, Roles, Schedule/Channels, and Ground Rules.
questions.explanation: Slide 4 (Unit 2): 4 thành phần cốt lõi của Team Charter: Goals (Mục tiêu), Roles (Vai trò), Schedule/Channels (Lịch & Kênh) và Ground Rules (Quy tắc).

questions.question: In T = (C + R + I) / S, how can a teammate most effectively increase their Trust score?
options: Never share opinions or commit to deadlines.
Increase Credibility, Reliability, and Intimacy while lowering Self-orientation.
Maximize Self-orientation to put themselves first.
Hide mistakes and blame junior members.
questions.correct_answer: Increase Credibility, Reliability, and Intimacy while lowering Self-orientation.
questions.explanation: Slide 5 (Unit 2): Để tăng Trust, cần tăng tử số (Credibility, Reliability, Intimacy) và giảm tối đa mẫu số Self-orientation (sự vị kỷ).

questions.question: A student asks a basic clarification question during a sprint and teammates answer kindly without mocking them. Which stage is present?
options: Learner safety.
Blocking safety.
Authoritarian control.
Social loafing.
questions.correct_answer: Learner safety.
questions.explanation: Slide 6 (Unit 2): Learner safety giúp thành viên an tâm đặt câu hỏi, thử nghiệm và mắc lỗi để học hỏi.

questions.question: How should a busy professional structure the body of a standard business email?
options: Write 12 long paragraphs of dense background history.
Type everything in red bold font.
Skip the greeting and subject line altogether.
Keep it concise, ideally under 3 short paragraphs with clear action items.
questions.correct_answer: Keep it concise, ideally under 3 short paragraphs with clear action items.
questions.explanation: Slide 7 (Unit 3): Email kinh doanh chuẩn chỉ nên dài tối đa 3 đoạn văn ngắn gọn, rõ ý.

questions.question: You are announcing a new internal office Wi-Fi password policy to company employees. Which format is best?
options: Unsolicited sales proposal.
Public press release.
Internal Memorandum (Memo).
Formal external Business Letter.
questions.correct_answer: Internal Memorandum (Memo).
questions.explanation: Slide 7–8 (Unit 3): Giao tiếp nội bộ trong cùng tổ chức sử dụng Memo (Header: To/From/Date/Subject).

questions.question: What differentiates a solicited proposal from an unsolicited proposal?
options: Only unsolicited proposals include an executive summary.
A solicited proposal responds directly to a client's published RFP.
A solicited proposal has no deadline or budget.
An unsolicited proposal is illegal in corporate business.
questions.correct_answer: A solicited proposal responds directly to a client's published RFP.
questions.explanation: Slide 9–12 (Unit 3): Solicited proposal được viết theo lời mời thầu / RFP chính thức của khách hàng.

questions.question: Which phrase is TOO abstract for an actionable project status update?
options: 'We will optimize synergy across deliverables soon.'
'We will reduce API response time from 400ms to 150ms by Friday.'
'Three QA engineers completed 45 test cases on Tuesday.'
'The marketing team shipped 2,000 brochures to campus.'
questions.correct_answer: 'We will optimize synergy across deliverables soon.'
questions.explanation: Slide 34 (Unit 10): 'Optimize synergy... soon' là từ ngữ trừu tượng, không đo lường được; văn viết chuyên nghiệp phải cụ thể (Concrete).

questions.question: Which writing style relies heavily on regional slang and spoken idioms unsuitable for formal business reports?
options: Formal.
Technical.
Executive.
Colloquial.
questions.correct_answer: Colloquial.
questions.explanation: Slide 34 (Unit 10): Colloquial là ngôn ngữ khẩu ngữ/tiếng lóng địa phương, không phù hợp cho báo cáo trang trọng.

questions.question: If you rewrite an author's paragraph in your own words at roughly the same length AND include a citation, what is this called?
options: Summarizing.
Editorial bias.
Ethical paraphrasing.
Plagiarism.
questions.correct_answer: Ethical paraphrasing.
questions.explanation: Slide 35–36 (Unit 11–12): Diễn đạt lại bằng lời của mình với độ dài tương đương KÈM trích dẫn nguồn đầy đủ là Paraphrasing hợp lệ.

questions.question: Which type of abstract summarizes the topic, methods, AND the key findings, conclusions, and recommendations?
options: Unsolicited hook.
Informational abstract.
Descriptive abstract.
Table of contents.
questions.correct_answer: Informational abstract.
questions.explanation: Slide 40 (Unit 12): Informational abstract bao gồm cả kết quả và khuyến nghị; Descriptive abstract chỉ nêu chủ đề và phương pháp.

questions.question: When presenting complex quarterly sales comparisons across 5 regions, what makes a report easiest to scan?
options: Clear headings, bullet points, and labeled charts or tables.
A 4-page uninterrupted block of prose.
Removing all section titles.
Using vague phrases like 'a lot' instead of numbers.
questions.correct_answer: Clear headings, bullet points, and labeled charts or tables.
questions.explanation: Slide 37–40 (Unit 12): Sử dụng tiêu đề rõ ràng, bảng biểu và biểu đồ có nhãn giúp báo cáo dễ đọc và chuyên nghiệp.

questions.question: How do daily tasks get coordinated inside a self-managing team?
options: The leader assigns every 15-minute task manually.
Nobody knows what the overall goal is.
External HR managers run every daily standup.
The leader sets overall goals, and team members autonomously manage daily operations.
questions.correct_answer: The leader sets overall goals, and team members autonomously manage daily operations.
questions.explanation: Slide 13–14 (Unit 4): Trong Self-managing team, leader đặt mục tiêu chung còn thành viên tự chủ điều phối công việc hằng ngày.

questions.question: A senior developer has mastered the codebase and consistently delivers high quality. According to Situational Leadership, what should the manager do?
options: Publicly criticize her independence.
Take back all her tasks and do them personally.
Delegate authority and grant high autonomy rather than micromanaging.
Give her hourly step-by-step checklists like a day-one intern.
questions.correct_answer: Delegate authority and grant high autonomy rather than micromanaging.
questions.explanation: Slide 14 (Unit 4): Situational Leadership điều chỉnh mức độ kèm cặp theo năng lực: nhân viên đã thành thạo nên được trao quyền tự chủ (Delegate).

questions.question: When a teammate asks you how to solve a design flaw, how does a 'Leader-as-Coach' respond?
options: Ignore them until the deadline passes.
Ask guiding questions so the teammate discovers and owns the solution.
Take their laptop and fix the code yourself.
Tell them to copy someone else's work without understanding.
questions.correct_answer: Ask guiding questions so the teammate discovers and owns the solution.
questions.explanation: Slide 14 (Unit 4): Leader-as-Coach đặt câu hỏi gợi mở để thành viên tự tư duy thay vì làm hộ.

questions.question: Why is 'I felt concerned when the file arrived late because our client demo was delayed' effective?
options: It expresses emotion and objective impact without attacking the listener's character.
It blames the listener aggressively.
It hides the real problem.
It avoids mentioning the client impact.
questions.correct_answer: It expresses emotion and objective impact without attacking the listener's character.
questions.explanation: Slide 19 (Unit 4–5): Câu cấu trúc 'I' trình bày cảm xúc + sự việc + tác động khách quan, tránh gây phòng thủ.

questions.question: Which situation MOST strongly justifies holding an in-person (face-to-face) meeting?
options: Sharing a routine weekly attendance spreadsheet.
Asking one teammate for a single file link.
Broadcasting a company holiday calendar.
Resolving a sensitive interpersonal conflict or charting a brand-new strategy.
questions.correct_answer: Resolving a sensitive interpersonal conflict or charting a brand-new strategy.
questions.explanation: Slide 20 (Unit 6): Họp trực tiếp ưu tiên cho các vấn đề nhạy cảm, xung đột hoặc hoạch định chiến lược mới.

questions.question: During a 30-minute meeting, one speaker has spent 18 minutes on a minor detail. What should the facilitator do?
options: Mute them without saying a word.
Roll their eyes visibly at other attendees.
Politely interrupt, note the time limit, and move to the next agenda item (parking the detail for later).
Let them talk until the meeting runs 2 hours over.
questions.correct_answer: Politely interrupt, note the time limit, and move to the next agenda item (parking the detail for later).
questions.explanation: Slide 20 (Unit 6): Điều phối viên cần lịch sự ngắt lời khi quá giờ để bảo vệ lịch trình chung của cả nhóm.

questions.question: Why is it dangerous to jump straight to solutions before defining the root cause of a problem?
options: Because root causes never affect outcomes.
The team may waste resources treating surface symptoms instead of fixing the real issue.
Because defining the problem always takes 6 months.
Because brainstorming is only for executives.
questions.correct_answer: The team may waste resources treating surface symptoms instead of fixing the real issue.
questions.explanation: Unit 7 - Chương 21–22: Nếu không xác định đúng Root Cause ở Bước 1, giải pháp đưa ra sẽ chỉ xử lý triệu chứng bề mặt.

questions.question: Which phrase is a sign of defensive communication rather than constructive dialogue?
options: 'Why are you always picking on my section?'
'Can you walk me through which numbers look off to you?'
'I see your point about the timeline; let's adjust.'
'Let's review the user feedback together.'
questions.correct_answer: 'Why are you always picking on my section?'
questions.explanation: Unit 7 - Chương 24: Phản ứng quy chụp ('Tại sao lúc nào bạn cũng soi mói phần của tôi?') là biểu hiện của giao tiếp phòng thủ.

questions.question: Backing up a budget request with audited ROI data and logical cause-effect steps relies on which appeal?
options: Pathos.
Ethos.
Mythos.
Logos.
questions.correct_answer: Logos.
questions.explanation: Slide 30 (Unit 8–9): Logos dựa vào lập luận logic, số liệu kiểm chứng và tính toán hiệu quả (ROI).

questions.question: What does it mean to say nonverbal communication is 'irreversible'?
options: Gestures can be edited out in real-time like a text message.
Facial expressions carry zero meaning in meetings.
Once a negative expression or gesture is seen, you cannot erase its initial impression.
Body language is always identical across every culture.
questions.correct_answer: Once a negative expression or gesture is seen, you cannot erase its initial impression.
questions.explanation: Slide 28 (Unit 8): Giao tiếp phi ngôn ngữ mang tính Irreversible (không thể rút lại sau khi đã thể hiện).

questions.question: How many words should a 30-to-60-second elevator speech roughly contain?
options: Over 3,000 words.
Around 100 words.
Around 1,200 words.
Exactly 10 words.
questions.correct_answer: Around 100 words.
questions.explanation: Slide 30 (Unit 9): Bài Elevator Speech 30–60 giây tương đương khoảng 100 từ ngắn gọn, súc tích.

questions.question: When pitching a safety-critical product to factory managers facing workplace accidents, which Maslow level should you address first?
options: Safety and security needs.
Self-actualization and artistic fulfillment.
Luxury status symbols.
Purely abstract philosophical ideals.
questions.correct_answer: Safety and security needs.
questions.explanation: Slide 30 (Unit 9): Phải đáp ứng các nhu cầu thiết yếu (Sinh lý & An toàn) trước khi nói đến nhu cầu bậc cao.

questions.question: Why do employers frequently reject candidates who have high technical grades but poor communication?
options: Because companies do not need technical skills at all.
Because high grades are illegal to verify.
Because soft skills cannot be learned.
Because modern workplace projects require teamwork, client communication, and adaptability.
questions.correct_answer: Because modern workplace projects require teamwork, client communication, and adaptability.
questions.explanation: Slide 3 & 43 (Unit 1 & 13): Kỹ năng mềm (giao tiếp, làm việc nhóm) là tiêu chí sàng lọc hàng đầu bên cạnh chuyên môn.

questions.question: How should your education and work experience be ordered on a modern résumé?
options: Alphabetical order by city name.
Random order.
Reverse chronological order (most recent first).
Oldest experience at the top, newest at the bottom.
questions.correct_answer: Reverse chronological order (most recent first).
questions.explanation: Slide 45 (Unit 13): Résumé chuẩn luôn sắp xếp theo thứ tự thời gian đảo ngược (Reverse chronological – mới nhất lên trên).

questions.question: What is wrong with writing 'Managed team of 5; duties incl. dev & QA' on an international résumé?
options: Describing QA experience.
Using abbreviations ('incl.', 'dev') violates standard professional résumé clarity.
Starting with the past-tense verb 'Managed'.
Mentioning a team size of 5.
questions.correct_answer: Using abbreviations ('incl.', 'dev') violates standard professional résumé clarity.
questions.explanation: Slide 45 (Unit 13): Trên Résumé chuyên nghiệp không nên dùng từ viết tắt tùy tiện (abbreviations) gây thiếu trang trọng.

questions.question: How should a Cover Letter complement a Résumé?
options: By telling a focused story that connects 2–3 relevant achievements directly to the job's needs.
By pasting the exact same résumé bullets word-for-word.
By listing all childhood hobbies.
By writing 5 pages of general autobiography.
questions.correct_answer: By telling a focused story that connects 2–3 relevant achievements directly to the job's needs.
questions.explanation: Slide 46 (Unit 13): Cover Letter kể câu chuyện kết nối 2–3 kinh nghiệm đắt giá nhất với yêu cầu vị trí tuyển dụng, không copy lại nguyên văn CV.

title: Đề 8 · Tổng Hợp Nâng Cao (Phủ Đủ Format Thi Thật)
description: 30 câu mới hoàn toàn tổng hợp toàn diện 54 Slide SSG105 từ Teamwork đến Career Readiness.

questions.question: In SSG105 Unit 1, which company increased productivity by 30% after adopting structured teamwork?
options: Xerox.
General Electric only.
A university library.
A solo freelance studio.
questions.correct_answer: Xerox.
questions.explanation: Slide 1–3 (Unit 1): Xerox tăng 30% năng suất, General Mills tăng 40%, FedEx giảm 13% lỗi nhờ làm việc nhóm hiệu quả.

questions.question: Five students in a dorm each study for their own separate math exam without sharing notes or grades. Are they a team or a group?
options: A high-performing self-managing team.
A formal cross-functional task force.
A team with high interdependence.
A group, because they have individual goals and individual accountability.
questions.correct_answer: A group, because they have individual goals and individual accountability.
questions.explanation: Slide 1–3 (Unit 1): Cá nhân hoạt động độc lập, mục tiêu riêng và đánh giá riêng là Group, không phải Team.

questions.question: Which action belongs to Task-facilitating roles rather than Relationship-building roles?
options: Praising a teammate's effort to boost morale.
Making jokes to relieve tension.
Monitoring project milestones and summarizing action items.
Mediating an emotional argument between two members.
questions.correct_answer: Monitoring project milestones and summarizing action items.
questions.explanation: Slide 3 (Unit 1): Task-facilitating roles tập trung vào công việc: cung cấp/tìm thông tin, theo dõi tiến độ (monitor).

questions.question: A junior team member proposes a novel workflow that contradicts the team's 3-year habit, and feels safe doing so. Which stage is this?
options: Passive compliance.
Challenger safety.
Inclusion safety.
Learner safety.
questions.correct_answer: Challenger safety.
questions.explanation: Slide 6 (Unit 2): Challenger safety là mức cao nhất: dám phản biện hiện trạng và đề xuất cách làm mới.

questions.question: In a student project group with no assigned leader, one member mocks others' ideas. Whose responsibility is it to fix the psychological safety?
options: Every member of the team.
Only the silent members.
Nobody, until the semester ends.
The university IT department.
questions.correct_answer: Every member of the team.
questions.explanation: Slide 6 (Unit 2): Khi không có trưởng nhóm chỉ định, trách nhiệm xây dựng Psychological Safety thuộc về tất cả thành viên.

questions.question: Why does high 'Self-orientation' destroy trust even if someone is very smart and reliable?
options: Because Self-orientation adds to Reliability.
Because smart people cannot work in teams.
Because Intimacy is multiplied by zero.
Because Self-orientation is in the denominator of the Trust Equation, dividing down Credibility, Reliability, and Intimacy.
questions.correct_answer: Because Self-orientation is in the denominator of the Trust Equation, dividing down Credibility, Reliability, and Intimacy.
questions.explanation: Slide 5 (Unit 2): T = (C + R + I) / S. Self-orientation (sự vị kỷ) nằm ở mẫu số nên S càng lớn thì niềm tin T càng giảm.

questions.question: Which email subject line is most effective for a busy project manager?
options: 'URGENT PLEASE READ NOW!!!!'
'Question'
'[JPD133] Draft Proposal Ready for Review – Feedback Needed by Thu 5PM'
'Hi'
questions.correct_answer: '[JPD133] Draft Proposal Ready for Review – Feedback Needed by Thu 5PM'
questions.explanation: Slide 7 (Unit 3): Subject line cần rõ ràng, cụ thể nội dung và hạn chót (tránh quá chung chung hoặc ALL CAPS).

questions.question: In a formal business letter, which punctuation marks follow the salutation and complimentary close?
options: Periods (.) after both.
A colon (:) after the salutation, and a comma (,) after the complimentary close.
A comma (,) after the salutation, and a colon (:) after the close.
Exclamation marks (!) after both.
questions.correct_answer: A colon (:) after the salutation, and a comma (,) after the complimentary close.
questions.explanation: Slide 8 (Unit 3): Quy tắc chuẩn Business Letter: Sau lời chào dùng dấu hai chấm (:), sau lời kết dùng dấu phẩy (,).

questions.question: When is a detailed Marketing Plan NOT necessary in a business proposal?
options: When bidding on a fixed one-time supply contract for a single organization.
When launching a public mobile app seeking 50,000 downloads.
When promoting a city-wide paid music festival.
When pitching a consumer subscription service.
questions.correct_answer: When bidding on a fixed one-time supply contract for a single organization.
questions.explanation: Slide 12 (Unit 3): Hợp đồng cung ứng hàng hóa cố định cho một đơn vị duy nhất không cần thu hút công chúng nên có thể lược bỏ Marketing Plan.

questions.question: Which sentence is clearer and more direct for business reporting?
options: '18 critical bugs were resolved by the engineering team before launch.'
'Critical bugs happened to be fixed prior to launching.'
'Resolution of bugs was achieved.'
'The engineering team resolved 18 critical bugs before launch.'
questions.correct_answer: 'The engineering team resolved 18 critical bugs before launch.'
questions.explanation: Slide 34 (Unit 10): Câu chủ động (Active voice) ngắn gọn, rõ chủ thể hành động và chuyên nghiệp hơn câu bị động.

questions.question: Why is citing an unverified viral social media statistic risky in a formal presentation?
options: Social media posts are always peer-reviewed.
It shortens the presentation by 10 minutes.
It damages your Ethos (credibility) if the audience checks and finds the claim false.
It automatically increases your Logos score.
questions.correct_answer: It damages your Ethos (credibility) if the audience checks and finds the claim false.
questions.explanation: Slide 35 (Unit 11): Dùng nguồn tin mạng chưa kiểm chứng làm tổn hại nghiêm trọng uy tín (Ethos) của người trình bày.

questions.question: Which organizational pattern presents an issue first, analyzes its impact, and then proposes concrete fixes?
options: Alphabetical.
Problem-solution.
Chronological.
Geographical.
questions.correct_answer: Problem-solution.
questions.explanation: Slide 36–40 (Unit 12): Mẫu Problem-solution đi từ mô tả vấn đề/tác động đến đề xuất giải pháp cụ thể.

questions.question: Which document is an Informational Report rather than an Analytical Report?
options: A weekly inventory count showing items currently in stock.
A feasibility study recommending whether to open a new branch.
A root-cause analysis advising changes to QA policy.
A vendor comparison recommending Supplier B.
questions.correct_answer: A weekly inventory count showing items currently in stock.
questions.explanation: Slide 37–40 (Unit 12): Bảng thống kê tồn kho hàng tuần chỉ đưa số liệu thực tế (Informational), không phân tích khuyến nghị.

questions.question: Reviewing user feedback mid-sprint to adjust an app's UI before final release is an example of:
options: Summative evaluation.
Ex-ante rejection.
Plagiarism.
Formative evaluation.
questions.correct_answer: Formative evaluation.
questions.explanation: Slide 41–42 (Unit 12): Đánh giá ngay trong quá trình triển khai để kịp thời điều chỉnh là Formative evaluation (khác với Summative đánh giá sau khi kết thúc dự án).

questions.question: A manager refuses to let teammates make minor formatting choices and rewrites every slide herself at 2 AM. What leadership error is this?
options: Healthy self-management.
High psychological safety.
Poor delegation / micromanagement.
Effective coaching.
questions.correct_answer: Poor delegation / micromanagement.
questions.explanation: Slide 2 & 13 (Unit 1 & 4): Quản lý vụn vặt, không biết ủy quyền (Poor delegation / micromanagement) làm giảm tinh thần và trễ tiến độ.

questions.question: A team lead shields her developers from sudden non-urgent requests from sales so they can finish the release. This is called:
options: Blocking behavior.
Managing team boundaries (acting as a buffer).
Social loafing.
Groupthink.
questions.correct_answer: Managing team boundaries (acting as a buffer).
questions.explanation: Slide 13 (Unit 4): Trưởng nhóm làm tấm đệm (buffer) bảo vệ nhóm khỏi nhiễu loạn bên ngoài gọi là Managing team boundaries.

questions.question: How should a virtual leader build trust with remote teammates across different time zones?
options: Focus on clear outcomes, transparent communication, and attentiveness to digital cues.
Expect instant 24/7 replies to casual messages.
Never hold video calls or one-on-one check-ins.
Judge performance solely by green online status icons.
questions.correct_answer: Focus on clear outcomes, transparent communication, and attentiveness to digital cues.
questions.explanation: Slide 14 (Unit 4–5): Virtual Leadership tập trung vào kết quả (outcomes), giao tiếp minh bạch và nhạy bén với tín hiệu số (digital cues).

questions.question: Why should every meeting have a written agenda sent out beforehand?
options: To make the meeting last twice as long.
To replace the need for meeting minutes.
To prevent attendees from asking questions.
So participants know the purpose, prepare input in advance, and stay on schedule.
questions.correct_answer: So participants know the purpose, prepare input in advance, and stay on schedule.
questions.explanation: Slide 20 (Unit 5–6): Gửi Agenda trước cuộc họp giúp mọi người chuẩn bị trước và bám sát mục tiêu thời gian.

questions.question: What is 'tactical reflection' during a tense team discussion?
options: Staying completely silent for five minutes.
Changing the topic immediately.
Restating the speaker's core message and emotion to confirm understanding before replying.
Repeating their words sarcastically to mock them.
questions.correct_answer: Restating the speaker's core message and emotion to confirm understanding before replying.
questions.explanation: Unit 7 - Chương 24: Phản chiếu chiến thuật (Tactical reflection) giúp hạ nhiệt căng thẳng bằng cách xác nhận bạn thực sự hiểu cảm xúc và ý của đối phương.

questions.question: Which feedback statement is properly goal-directed?
options: 'I am personally angry at you.'
'Our goal is 95% test coverage by Friday; missing today's unit tests puts us 15% behind that target, so let's pair up tomorrow.'
'You are always irresponsible and ruining our grades.'
'Never mind, deadlines don't matter anyway.'
questions.correct_answer: 'Our goal is 95% test coverage by Friday; missing today's unit tests puts us 15% behind that target, so let's pair up tomorrow.'
questions.explanation: Unit 7 - Chương 24: Goal-directed feedback gắn hành vi cần sửa với mục tiêu chung (target) và hướng giải quyết.

questions.question: Why must criticism be suspended during the initial brainstorming phase?
options: Because early criticism shuts down creativity and prevents wild ideas that could spark strong solutions.
Because every single wild idea will be funded automatically.
Because teams should never evaluate ideas at all.
Because only the leader's ideas matter.
questions.correct_answer: Because early criticism shuts down creativity and prevents wild ideas that could spark strong solutions.
questions.explanation: Unit 7 - Chương 21–22: Phán xét quá sớm làm thui chột sáng tạo; đánh giá nên để sang bước sau khi đã thu thập đủ ý tưởng.

questions.question: Which skill is part of Self-Regulation in Emotional Intelligence?
options: Exploding in anger during a client call.
Blaming teammates immediately when a bug appears.
Refusing to acknowledge your own triggers.
Pausing to calm down before replying to an upsetting email.
questions.correct_answer: Pausing to calm down before replying to an upsetting email.
questions.explanation: Slide 19 (Unit 4): Tự điều chỉnh (Self-regulation) là khả năng kiểm soát cảm xúc bốc đồng trước khi phản ứng.

questions.question: When presenting to a large room, why should slides avoid full paragraphs of tiny text?
options: Because paragraphs cannot be printed.
Because audiences prefer blank white screens for 20 minutes.
The audience will read the text instead of listening to the speaker, and tiny text is unreadable.
Because short bullet points require fewer colors.
questions.correct_answer: The audience will read the text instead of listening to the speaker, and tiny text is unreadable.
questions.explanation: Slide 54 (Unit 8): Slide chỉ nên chứa từ khóa/ý chính cỡ chữ >= 24pt để khán giả tập trung nghe diễn giả nói.

questions.question: What does avoiding eye contact and slouching with crossed arms communicate to an audience?
options: Deep preparation.
Disengagement, nervousness, or defensiveness.
Strong executive presence.
Warm enthusiasm.
questions.correct_answer: Disengagement, nervousness, or defensiveness.
questions.explanation: Slide 28 (Unit 8): Khoanh tay, cúi người và né tránh ánh mắt truyền tín hiệu phòng thủ hoặc thiếu tự tin.

questions.question: Which combination represents Aristotle's three pillars of persuasion?
options: Ethos (credibility), Logos (logic), and Pathos (emotion).
Size, Similarity, and Success.
Goals, Roles, and Rules.
Subject, Body, and Signature.
questions.correct_answer: Ethos (credibility), Logos (logic), and Pathos (emotion).
questions.explanation: Slide 30 (Unit 8–9): 3 trụ cột thuyết phục của Aristotle là Ethos (Uy tín), Logos (Logic) và Pathos (Cảm xúc).

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 'Attention Statement' at the start of an elevator speech?
options: To list your home address and marital status.
To apologize for taking their time.
To read a 5-page bibliography.
To hook the listener's interest within the first few seconds.
questions.correct_answer: To hook the listener's interest within the first few seconds.
questions.explanation: Slide 30 (Unit 9): Attention Statement (Hook) dùng để thu hút sự chú ý của người nghe ngay trong những giây đầu tiên.

questions.question: Which skill set best characterizes a 'career-ready' graduate?
options: Working strictly alone without ever receiving feedback.
Having zero interest in industry trends.
Combining technical competence with teamwork, communication, and workplace adaptability.
Only memorizing textbook definitions for multiple-choice exams.
questions.correct_answer: Combining technical competence with teamwork, communication, and workplace adaptability.
questions.explanation: Slide 43 (Unit 13): Career-ready đòi hỏi sự kết hợp giữa chuyên môn kỹ thuật và kỹ năng mềm (làm việc nhóm, giao tiếp, thích nghi).

questions.question: Which bullet point follows international résumé standards?
options: 'Age 22, single, expected salary $1,500.'
'Developed an automated test suite that reduced regression bugs by 30%.'
'I was tasked with testing software and stuff.'
'Tests were written by me during the summer.'
questions.correct_answer: 'Developed an automated test suite that reduced regression bugs by 30%.'
questions.explanation: Slide 45 (Unit 13): Dùng động từ hành động mạnh đầu câu + kết quả định lượng cụ thể, không dùng 'I', bị động hay thông tin cá nhân cấm.

questions.question: For a university graduate with 1–2 internships, what is the ideal résumé length?
options: 1 page (at most 2 pages for extensive experience), with NO headshot photo.
4 to 5 pages with a large studio portrait.
Half a page with no project descriptions.
10 pages including high school grades.
questions.correct_answer: 1 page (at most 2 pages for extensive experience), with NO headshot photo.
questions.explanation: Slide 45 (Unit 13): Résumé chuẩn dài 1–2 trang và KHÔNG gắn ảnh chân dung.

questions.question: Which approach makes a Cover Letter stand out to recruiters?
options: Sending the exact same generic letter to 200 companies without changing the company name.
Repeating every line from your résumé verbatim.
Listing demands for vacation days in paragraph one.
Tailoring 2–3 concrete STAR stories to show how you solve the specific company's needs.
questions.correct_answer: Tailoring 2–3 concrete STAR stories to show how you solve the specific company's needs.
questions.explanation: Slide 46 (Unit 13): Cover Letter hiệu quả cần cá nhân hóa theo công ty và dùng mô hình STAR cho 2–3 thành tích nổi bật nhất.

title: Đề 9 · Đề Thi Thật SU26-FE (30 câu)
description: Bộ đề thi thật SU26-FE (30 câu chuẩn cấu trúc 4–5 lựa chọn) kèm giải thích chi tiết theo Slide SSG105.

questions.question: Which statement expresses high emotional intelligence?
options: "They are disrespecting me."
"Why am I so bad at this?"
"I feel unheard when I'm interrupted during meetings."
"You always ignore my input"
"I'm fine"
questions.correct_answer: "I feel unheard when I'm interrupted during meetings."
questions.explanation: Slide 19 (Unit 4 - EQ): Giao tiếp bằng câu cấu trúc 'I' (I-statement) bày tỏ cảm xúc và tình huống cụ thể một cách khách quan mà không công kích hay quy chụp người khác.

questions.question: In a group project without a clear leader, who is responsible for establishing psychological safety?
options: The course instructor.
Every member of the team.
The team member with the most technical skills.
The person who created the team charter.
questions.correct_answer: Every member of the team.
questions.explanation: Slide 6 (Unit 2): Khi không có trưởng nhóm chỉ định, trách nhiệm xây dựng môi trường an toàn tâm lý (Psychological Safety) thuộc về TẤT CẢ thành viên trong nhóm.

questions.question: Which example illustrates situational leadership?
options: A restaurant shift supervisor manages by standard operating procedures...
The founder of an environmental non-profit...

A manager hires a new graduate. For the first month, the manager gives him step-by-step instructions. Six months later, as the employee becomes highly competent and confident, the manager gives him full autonomy over his own projects.
When a junior engineer presents a wild, unproven idea...
questions.correct_answer: A manager hires a new graduate. For the first month, the manager gives him step-by-step instructions. Six months later, as the employee becomes highly competent and confident, the manager gives him full autonomy over his own projects.
questions.explanation: Slide 14 (Unit 4 - Situational Leadership): Lãnh đạo tình huống điều chỉnh mức độ hướng dẫn/ủy quyền linh hoạt dựa trên năng lực và sự trưởng thành của nhân viên theo thời gian.

questions.question: A leader needs to tell his team that they fail to get a funding for their project. Which is an inappropriate facial expression when delivering the news?
options: Focused and steady gaze
Smiling or letting out a nervous chuckle
Calm absorbing nod
Serious and empathetic eye contact
Relaxed eyebrows
questions.correct_answer: Smiling or letting out a nervous chuckle
questions.explanation: Slide 28 (Unit 8 - Nonverbal): Khi thông báo tin xấu (rớt tài trợ), việc mỉm cười hoặc cười gượng là biểu cảm không phù hợp, làm mất uy tín và sự đồng cảm.

questions.question: What is inappropriate when presenting a graduation thesis?
options: Wearing a well-fitted suit or a formal dress-and-blazer combination in neutral colors
Standing directly in front of your slides and reading the text off the screen
Standing at a slight angle between the presentation screen and the committee table
Holding the slide clicker lightly in one hand, dropping it to your side when not using it
questions.correct_answer: Standing directly in front of your slides and reading the text off the screen
questions.explanation: Slide 28 & 54 (Unit 8): Khi thuyết trình cần đứng chếch góc giữ giao tiếp mắt với hội đồng, tuyệt đối tránh đứng chắn màn hình và đọc nguyên văn chữ trên slide.

questions.question:
In the following case, which action demonstrates the stage of establishing criteria in the problem-solving process?
"A student group is working on a marketing presentation worth 30% of their final grade. Hung has gone completely silent for 4 days and hasn't done his 3 assigned slides."
options: The team looks into why this problem is happening.
The team identifies the exact issue.
The team decides what a "good" solution must look like.
Team members brainstorm several different paths forward.
The team checks if the solution actually worked.
questions.correct_answer: The team decides what a "good" solution must look like.
questions.explanation: Unit 7 - Chương 21–22 (7 bước giải quyết vấn đề): Establishing criteria (Thiết lập tiêu chí) là xác định trước một giải pháp 'tốt' cần đáp ứng những yêu cầu/chuẩn mực nào.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of the "reflection" stage when overcoming barriers in written communication?
options: To instantly change words with synonyms to ensure a higher overall word count.
To review the key points mentally and ensure each specific detail serves its purpose.
To distribute the rough draft to a large audience for immediate verbal feedback.
To ensure the finalized document uses the maximum number of complex sentences.
questions.correct_answer: To review the key points mentally and ensure each specific detail serves its purpose.
questions.explanation: Unit 10 (Overcoming Barriers in Writing): Giai đoạn Reflection giúp người viết rà soát lại các ý chính trong đầu và đảm bảo mọi chi tiết đều phục vụ đúng mục đích giao tiếp.

questions.question: When a speaker manages facts, ideas, or points of view to deliberately play upon the audience's inherent insecurities or fears to their own distinct advantage, what unethical practice are they committing?
options: Coercion
Deception
Manipulation
Bribery
questions.correct_answer: Manipulation
questions.explanation: Unit 9 (Ethics in Persuasion): Cố tình bóp méo, sắp đặt thông tin để lợi dụng nỗi sợ/sự bất an của khán giả nhằm trục lợi cho bản thân là hành vi Thao túng (Manipulation).

questions.question: What DOES NOT make a social project proposal more persuasive?
options: Evidence
Financial transparency
Realistic plan
Careful assessment of risks
Massive goals
questions.correct_answer: Massive goals
questions.explanation: Slide 9–12 (Unit 3): Đề xuất dự án xã hội thuyết phục nhờ bằng chứng (Evidence), minh bạch tài chính, kế hoạch thực tế (Realistic) và đánh giá rủi ro; mục tiêu quá khổng lồ/viển vông (Massive goals) làm giảm tính khả thi.

questions.question: What is appropriate when emailing a professor to notify them about a class absence?
options: Clear notice of the date and a brief, respectful reason
Using slang
Giving a post-absence notice without justification
Asking for "Present" attendance check
Sharing highly personal details
questions.correct_answer: Clear notice of the date and a brief, respectful reason
questions.explanation: Slide 7 (Unit 3 - Email Netiquette): Email xin nghỉ học chuẩn mực cần nêu rõ ngày vắng, lý do ngắn gọn, lịch sự (không dùng tiếng lóng hay kể chi tiết quá riêng tư).

questions.question: You needs to write a proposal asking the company's executive team to approve a budget for transitioning the customer support team to an AI-powered chatbot system. Which question is optional to ask when determining the purpose of your document?
options: "When does this take place?"
"What is the core message and call to action?"
"Why is this urgently necessary right now?"
"Where will this document live and operate?"
"How should the tone and structure be formatted?"
questions.correct_answer: "Why is this urgently necessary right now?"
questions.explanation: Unit 10 (Planning Your Document): Khi xác định mục đích văn bản, các câu hỏi What/When/Where/How giúp định hình thông điệp, ngữ cảnh và cấu trúc; câu hỏi 'Why urgently right now' mang tính tùy chọn.

questions.question: How are "hard skills" distinct from "soft skills"?
options: Hard skills are difficult to learn, while soft skills can be mastered in a single afternoon workshop.
Hard skills apply only to physical manufacturing, while soft skills apply exclusively to office roles.
Hard skills are technical or specialized abilities, while soft skills are general, transferable traits like teamwork.
Hard skills disappear over time, while soft skills remain permanently fixed without any practice.
questions.correct_answer: Hard skills are technical or specialized abilities, while soft skills are general, transferable traits like teamwork.
questions.explanation: Slide 43 (Unit 13): Hard skills là năng lực kỹ thuật/chuyên môn đặc thù, còn Soft skills là kỹ năng tổng quát có thể chuyển đổi qua nhiều công việc (làm việc nhóm, giao tiếp...).

questions.question: What are the primary methods through which effective business writing is learned?
options: Through watching verbal presentations and observing the physical gestures of experienced speakers.
Through memorizing extensive vocabulary lists and utilizing complex theoretical frameworks.
Through avoiding any revisions and focusing entirely on producing a perfect first draft immediately.
Through continuous practice, reading professional documents, and receiving constructive feedback.
questions.correct_answer: Through continuous practice, reading professional documents, and receiving constructive feedback.
questions.explanation: Slide 34 (Unit 10): Kỹ năng viết văn bản thương mại hiệu quả được hình thành qua thực hành liên tục, đọc các tài liệu chuyên nghiệp và tiếp thu phản hồi mang tính xây dựng.

questions.question: You are arguing for a remote-work policy. You state your claim clearly, but the board is highly skeptical about employee productivity at home. How should you design your argument to navigate this effectively?
options: Ignore their skepticism to maintain a confident tone and focus solely on the benefits of remote work.
Condense the entire argument into a brief summary so the board does not have time to find flaws.
State a clear thesis, address the board's concerns as counterarguments, and provide evidence on how you will handle productivity risks.
Restate the board's past failures in management in your own words to prove that their current skepticism is invalid.
questions.correct_answer: State a clear thesis, address the board's concerns as counterarguments, and provide evidence on how you will handle productivity risks.
questions.explanation: Slide 36–40 (Unit 12): Lập luận thuyết phục khi đối phương hoài nghi cần nêu luận điểm rõ, chủ động giải quyết các phản biện (counterarguments) và đưa bằng chứng kiểm soát rủi ro.

questions.question: What is NOT a result of high emotional intelligence?
options: An ability to make sound decisions
Better relationships
Stronger collaboration
No negative emotions
A high level of empathy
questions.correct_answer: No negative emotions
questions.explanation: Slide 19 (Unit 4 - EQ): EQ cao KHÔNG có nghĩa là không bao giờ có cảm xúc tiêu cực; con người vẫn có cảm xúc tiêu cực nhưng biết nhận diện và điều chỉnh chúng lành mạnh.

questions.question: You have restated a research paper's business model in your own words and matched its original length. To avoid plagiarism, what is your next essential step?
options: Condense the text further into a summary.
Credit the original source appropriately.
Change the overall document design and headings.
Address the counterarguments of the business model.
questions.correct_answer: Credit the original source appropriately.
questions.explanation: Slide 35–36 (Unit 11–12): Dù đã Paraphrase hoàn toàn bằng ngôn từ cá nhân, vẫn BẮT BUỘC phải trích dẫn nguồn gốc (credit the original source) để không bị đạo văn.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of a persuasive presentation?
options: To create an engaging conversation that attract the audience while sparking curiosity.
To influence the audience's beliefs, attitudes, or actions through carefully structured arguments and appeals.
To provide controversial information and allow the audience to draw their conclusions independently.
To narrate a compelling personal story that resonates emotionally with the audience without necessarily requiring action.
questions.correct_answer: To influence the audience's beliefs, attitudes, or actions through carefully structured arguments and appeals.
questions.explanation: Slide 30 (Unit 9): Mục đích chính của thuyết trình thuyết phục (Persuasive presentation) là tác động đến niềm tin, thái độ hoặc hành động của khán giả bằng lập luận và các trụ cột thuyết phục.

questions.question: When does plagiarism occur?
options: When you restate another writer's idea in your own words and provide a citation
When you condense a long article into a short summary with proper credits
When you organize your main points before starting a draft
When you use someone else's words or ideas as your own
questions.correct_answer: When you use someone else's words or ideas as your own
questions.explanation: Slide 35–36 (Unit 11–12): Đạo văn (Plagiarism) xảy ra khi sử dụng câu chữ hoặc ý tưởng của người khác như thể của chính mình mà không ghi nguồn trích dẫn.

questions.question: What does NOT demonstrate business ethics to uphold in professional writing?
options: Absolute transparency
Distorting data
Clear distinction between fact and opinion
Active voice and clear language
Showing respect for readers
questions.correct_answer: Distorting data
questions.explanation: Slide 34–35 (Unit 10–11): Bóp méo số liệu (Distorting data) vi phạm nghiêm trọng đạo đức nghề nghiệp trong văn bản kinh doanh.

questions.question: When constructing a comprehensive Career Action Plan, what is the most effective method for structuring goals and actions?
options: Focus exclusively on long-term 20-year goals while ignoring immediate action items.
List as many unmeasured goals as possible without assigning any realistic dates or execution parameters.
Copy the exact action plan of a senior professional to ensure uniform tracking metrics.
Set short-term goals alongside mid-term goals, all supported by concrete, actionable steps.
questions.correct_answer: Set short-term goals alongside mid-term goals, all supported by concrete, actionable steps.
questions.explanation: Slide 43–46 (Unit 13): Kế hoạch hành động nghề nghiệp hiệu quả phải kết hợp mục tiêu ngắn hạn + trung hạn, đi kèm các bước hành động cụ thể.

questions.question: What percentage of Fortune 1000 companies use self-managing teams?
questions.explanation: Slide 13–14 (Unit 4): Theo số liệu trong giáo trình SSG105, có 79% các công ty thuộc Fortune 1000 sử dụng mô hình nhóm tự quản (Self-managing teams).

questions.question: If a drafted résumé contains excessive abbreviations, personal lifestyle details, expected salary, and spans over three pages for an entry-level role, which revisions should be prioritized?
options: Remove personal details, eliminate salary expectations, expand abbreviations, and condense to 1-2 pages.
Keep the content identical but change the font to an ornate style to attract visual attention.
Remove contact information to preserve privacy, and add a detailed physical description instead.
Keep the three-page structure but append a comprehensive list of all high school coursework.
questions.correct_answer: Remove personal details, eliminate salary expectations, expand abbreviations, and condense to 1-2 pages.
questions.explanation: Slide 45 (Unit 13 - Résumé Standards): Résumé chuẩn chỉ dài 1–2 trang, loại bỏ thông tin cá nhân/mức lương mong muốn và viết đầy đủ không dùng từ viết tắt tùy tiện.

questions.question: When sharing the work in a team project, what is often more important than the final product?
options: The learning experience.
Doing all the work yourself.
The frequency of missed deadlines.
The informal ground rules.
questions.correct_answer: The learning experience.
questions.explanation: Slide 4 (Unit 2 - Class Team Projects): Trong các dự án nhóm học phần, trải nghiệm học tập (learning experience) quan trọng hơn sản phẩm cuối cùng.

questions.question: In which of these examples is a group meeting unnecessary?
options: A student group changes the entire direction of their social project mid-way through.
A corporate team launches a major quarterly initiative.
The engineering team refuses to build a feature because it takes too long, while the marketing team insists it is vital for the launch.
A team needs to create a list of potential sponsors for a charity gala.
Drafting a proposal for the group project.
questions.correct_answer: A team needs to create a list of potential sponsors for a charity gala.
questions.explanation: Slide 20 (Unit 6): Việc lập danh sách tài trợ tiềm năng có thể làm cá nhân rồi chia sẻ qua Google Docs/chat, không cần tổ chức cuộc họp nhóm trực tiếp.

questions.question: Which is NOT a topic for a social project proposal?
options: A student-led bike share and repair hub
Weekly STEM workshops for underrepresented youth
Implementing an AI-driven customer service chatbot for an e-commerce brand
Combatting heat-related illness in urban homeless populations
questions.correct_answer: Implementing an AI-driven customer service chatbot for an e-commerce brand
questions.explanation: Unit 3 (Social Project Proposal): Chatbot chăm sóc khách hàng cho thương hiệu thương mại điện tử là dự án kinh doanh thương mại (business/profit), không phải dự án xã hội cộng đồng.

questions.question:
Which feedback from the leader in the following case is a goal-directed feedback?
"The Campus Food Rescue is a student-run social project designed to reduce campus food waste. Every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at closing time, students safely weigh, log, and transport the campus leftover meals to the local shelter. Lam, one member of the logistics team, forgot to check the volunteer schedule, causing 40 pounds of food to be thrown away on Wednesday night."
options: "Lam, you need to be more responsible. Missing your volunteer shift like this isn't acceptable because everyone depends on you."
"Lam, I had to apologize to the cafeteria staff for twenty minutes because no one showed up, and it was incredibly embarrassing."
"Hey Lam, don't worry about Wednesday night! The cafeteria staff will get over it, and you're doing a great job overall."
"Lam, our logistics team is aimed at ensuring a 100% reliable pickup schedule so no food gets thrown away. Because Wednesday's shift went uncovered, we fell short of that target."
questions.correct_answer: "Lam, our logistics team is aimed at ensuring a 100% reliable pickup schedule so no food gets thrown away. Because Wednesday's shift went uncovered, we fell short of that target."
questions.explanation: Unit 7 - Chương 24 (Goal-directed Feedback): Phản hồi hướng mục tiêu đối chiếu trực tiếp sai sót với mục tiêu chung (target) của nhóm thay vì chỉ trích cá nhân hay né tránh vấn đề.

questions.question: What is NOT true about conflict in teamwork?
options: Leaders shoud avoid conflict at all costs.
There are many different sources of conflict for a team.
If handled poorly, it can create distrust within a group.
It can be constructive for team development.
questions.correct_answer: Leaders shoud avoid conflict at all costs.
questions.explanation: Unit 7 (Conflict Management): Xung đột không phải lúc nào cũng xấu; nếu quản lý tốt nó giúp nhóm phát triển mang tính xây dựng. Quan điểm 'tránh xung đột bằng mọi giá' là SAI.

questions.question:
What is the main problem with the following excerpt from the meeting minutes?
"Trang presented a wonderful, highly creative idea for the club's Gala dinner. Unsurprisingly, Tuan immediately started whining about the budget and shut down her ideas in a really rude, insensitive tone. He tried to force the team to buy cheap food from a local buffet, which would make our club look incredibly unprofessional to the whole university."
options: Introducing editorial bias or emotion
Lack of "next-step" mechanics
Total ambiguity
Over-detailing
Informal language
questions.correct_answer: Introducing editorial bias or emotion
questions.explanation: Slide 20 (Unit 6 - Meeting Minutes): Dùng các từ ngữ cảm tính, thiên vị ('wonderful', 'whining', 'rude', 'unprofessional') là lỗi nghiêm trọng Editorial bias / cảm xúc cá nhân trong biên bản.

questions.question: According to the "Five Key Drivers", how does team size affect group cohesiveness?
options: Bigger teams lead to higher satisfaction.
Bigger teams lead to lower satisfaction and more conflict
Size does not affect cohesiveness
Bigger teams make entry harder and increase status
questions.correct_answer: Bigger teams lead to lower satisfaction and more conflict
questions.explanation: Slide 2 (Unit 1 - 5 Drivers): Nhóm càng lớn thì sự gắn kết và hài lòng càng giảm, dễ phát sinh xung đột (nhóm càng nhỏ càng hài lòng).

questions.question:
Which level of Maslow's hierarchy of needs is refered to in the following statement?
"Fostering a collaborative, inclusive culture where team members feel seen and valued as individuals."
options: Physiological needs
Safety needs
Love and belonging
Esteem
Self-actualization
questions.correct_answer: Love and belonging
questions.explanation: Unit 4 - Chương 16 (Maslow): Xây dựng văn hóa hợp tác, hòa nhập giúp thành viên cảm thấy gắn kết và được thuộc về tập thể thuộc tầng Love and belonging.

title: Đề 10 · Đề Thi Thật SSG105_SU26_RE (30 câu)
description: Bộ đề thi thật SSG105_SU26_RE (30 câu chuẩn cấu trúc 4–5 lựa chọn) kèm giải thích tiếng Việt theo Slide.

questions.question:
"Four university seniors are assigned a semester-long capstone project worth 50% of their final grade. Their goal is to design a sustainable rooftop garden proposal for the campus library. One member, overwhelmed by her course load, makes a major calculation error in the structural load report. She uploads it to the shared drive without double-checking."

In the given case, what is the most constructive feedback from the team leader?
options: "Your math is completely wrong on page 3 and you are going to ruin our project grade. How could you be this careless right before the deadline?"
"This layout is a mess because you didn't check your numbers. Now the whole team has to stay up all night to fix them"

"I know you've been overwhelmed by your heavy course load, so don't sweat the math error on page 3; let's get it fixed tonight, and next time we'll make sure someone double-checks the draft with you."
"If you couldn't handle the engineering section with your heavy course load, you should have just told us instead of turning in flawed work."
questions.correct_answer: "I know you've been overwhelmed by your heavy course load, so don't sweat the math error on page 3; let's get it fixed tonight, and next time we'll make sure someone double-checks the draft with you."
questions.explanation: Unit 7 - Chương 24 (Constructive Feedback): Phản hồi mang tính xây dựng thể hiện sự thấu cảm với áp lực của thành viên, không công kích cá nhân và tập trung vào giải pháp khắc phục cùng cơ chế kiểm tra chéo cho lần sau.

questions.question:
Which way of building leadership skills is illustrated in the following statement:

"Treat every team project as a chance to experiment with better leadership behaviours. Each opportunity helps you practise planning, delegating, and following up."
options: Learning by leading small tasks
Developing self-awareness
Building emotional intelligence
Relationship-building
Practice constructive communication
questions.correct_answer: Learning by leading small tasks
questions.explanation: Slide 13–14 (Unit 4): Rèn luyện kỹ năng lãnh đạo bằng cách tận dụng từng dự án/công việc nhỏ (leading small tasks) để thực hành lập kế hoạch, ủy quyền và theo dõi tiến độ.

questions.question: What is NOT suitable when preparing to write a social project proposal?
options: Prepare a transparent spreadsheet breaking down every single cost
Define project goals using the SMART framework
Create a project timeline or workflow that assumes perfect conditions
Gather concrete data, surveys or interviews directly from the target community
Outline exactly how success will measured
questions.correct_answer: Create a project timeline or workflow that assumes perfect conditions
questions.explanation: Slide 9–12 (Unit 3): Khi lập đề xuất dự án xã hội, cần có kế hoạch thực tế và dự phòng rủi ro; việc lập tiến độ giả định mọi điều kiện đều hoàn hảo là phi thực tế và không phù hợp.

questions.question:
"A senior developer is preparing a technical documentation brief for their immediate software engineering team detailing a new database migration plan. Because all the readers are expert-level, her preparation is straightforward. She can skip explanations of basic concepts and use heavy, technical jargon from the very first sentence."

Which aspect of the audience is considered in the given case?
options: Audience size
Audience composition
Audience preference
Audience mood
Audience intelligence
questions.correct_answer: Audience intelligence
questions.explanation: Unit 10 (Audience Analysis): Xem xét trình độ chuyên môn và mức độ am hiểu kiến thức nền của người đọc (expert-level) để quyết định dùng thuật ngữ chuyên sâu thuộc yếu tố Audience intelligence.

questions.question: How should a team handle mistakes to maintain psychological safety?
options: Blame the person who caused the mistake.
Exclude the member from future decisions
Use a forward-looking approach and ask how to improve next time.
Stop sharing knowledge to avoid more mistakes
questions.correct_answer: Use a forward-looking approach and ask how to improve next time.
questions.explanation: Slide 6 (Unit 2 - Learner Safety): Để duy trì an toàn tâm lý, nhóm cần tiếp cận sai sót theo hướng nhìn về tương lai (forward-looking) và cùng tìm cách cải thiện thay vì đổ lỗi hay trừng phạt.

questions.question: What does "intimacy" mean in the Trust Equation?
options: What you say and know.
Whether you follow through consistently.
Whether you focus on yourself.
How safe others feel sharing with you.
questions.correct_answer: How safe others feel sharing with you.
questions.explanation: Slide 5 (Unit 2 - Trust Equation): Intimacy đo mức độ an toàn và tin cậy mà người khác cảm nhận khi chia sẻ thông tin thẳng thắn với bạn.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the marketing plan in a social project proposal?
options: To define the target audience and outline exactly how the project will reach them
To take market share away from competitors
To promote the personal brand of the project leaders
To make the project look good
questions.correct_answer: To define the target audience and outline exactly how the project will reach them
questions.explanation: Slide 12 (Unit 3): Marketing plan trong đề xuất dự án xã hội nhằm xác định đúng đối tượng thụ hưởng/mục tiêu và kế hoạch tiếp cận họ hiệu quả.

questions.question: What does a Case Study report do?
options: Assess the need for a service or product
Analyze a specific example and present the core lessons learned
Analyze problems and predict whether current solutions
Describe one-time events, such as trips, conferences, seminars
Monitor and control production, sales, shipping, service, or related business process
questions.correct_answer: Analyze a specific example and present the core lessons learned
questions.explanation: Slide 37–40 (Unit 12): Case Study report phân tích chuyên sâu một tình huống/ví dụ cụ thể để rút ra các bài học kinh nghiệm cốt lõi.

questions.question: In which context is writing emails appropriate?
options: When the topic is emotionally charged or involves conflict
When the matter is highly urgent
When a paper trail is needed
When handling highly confidential information
questions.correct_answer: When a paper trail is needed
questions.explanation: Slide 7 (Unit 3 & 6): Email phù hợp nhất khi cần lưu lại dấu vết văn bản/lịch sử trao đổi chính thức (paper trail); không phù hợp cho xung đột cảm xúc, việc khẩn cấp hay thông tin tối mật.

questions.question: Why is it important to provide constructive feedback?
options: To focus only on the positive factors.
To reinforce negative behavior.
To manipulate others' emotions.
To examine what is working and areas for improvement.
questions.correct_answer: To examine what is working and areas for improvement.
questions.explanation: Unit 7 - Chương 24: Phản hồi xây dựng giúp rà soát khách quan những điểm đang làm tốt và những khía cạnh cần cải thiện để nâng cao hiệu quả chung.

questions.question: What is likely to happen when we jump straight into brainstorming solutions without a clear problem statement?
