options: Data and logic win the debate.
Creative energy is not channelled toward a single, unified target.
We have higher chance of solving the exact issue holding the team back.
The scope of the project is established.
questions.correct_answer: Creative energy is not channelled toward a single, unified target.
questions.explanation: Unit 7 - Chương 21–22: Nếu không xác định rõ vấn đề ở Bước 1, ý tưởng sáng tạo trong Brainstorming sẽ bị phân tán, không hướng vào đúng một mục tiêu thống nhất.

questions.question: What is NOT a characteristic of constructive feedback?
options: Non-judgmental language
Ambiguity
Respecting boundaries
Solution-oriented
questions.correct_answer: Ambiguity
questions.explanation: Unit 7 - Chương 24: Phản hồi xây dựng phải cụ thể, rõ ràng, không phán xét, tôn trọng ranh giới và hướng giải pháp; sự mơ hồ (Ambiguity) làm phản hồi mất tác dụng.

questions.question: What are the core values of an effective business writing style?
options: Complexity, detail, and emotional language
Ambiguity, politeness, and formal vocabulary
Clarity, brevity, and professionalism
Passivity, creativity, and subjective tone
questions.correct_answer: Clarity, brevity, and professionalism
questions.explanation: Slide 34 (Unit 10): Giá trị cốt lõi của văn phong kinh doanh hiệu quả là Rõ ràng (Clarity), Ngắn gọn súc tích (Brevity) và Chuyên nghiệp (Professionalism).

questions.question: A team member drafts a summary of an industry article but forgets to credit the original source, assuming that changing the words is enough. Why is this structurally problematic in academic writing?
options: Even when paraphrasing or summarizing, failing to credit the source still constitutes plagiarism because the core ideas are not original.
The team member failed to maintain the roughly similar length of the original article, which is required for a summary.
Summaries must use the exact wording of the original text; only paraphrasing allows for changing the vocabulary.
The document lacks a clear problem-solution organizational pattern, which makes the uncredited information confusing.
questions.correct_answer: Even when paraphrasing or summarizing, failing to credit the source still constitutes plagiarism because the core ideas are not original.
questions.explanation: Slide 35–36 (Unit 11–12): Cả Paraphrase và Summary đều BẮT BUỘC phải ghi nguồn trích dẫn; nếu quên ghi nguồn vẫn bị tính là đạo văn (Plagiarism).

questions.question: You are writing a report detailing the step-by-step process of launching a new product over the last six months. Which organizational pattern should you apply?
options: Compare-contrast
Cause-effect
Chronological (time order)
Problem-solution
questions.correct_answer: Chronological (time order)
questions.explanation: Slide 36 (Unit 12): Khi trình bày quy trình từng bước diễn ra theo tiến trình thời gian (trong 6 tháng qua), ta dùng mẫu tổ chức Chronological (trình tự thời gian).

questions.question: A project manager needs to submit a weekly status update. By utilizing a pre-designed template to complete the task accurately within a tight deadline, the manager is primarily demonstrating which characteristic of good writing?
options: Efficiency
Pathos
Creativity
Empathy
questions.correct_answer: Efficiency
questions.explanation: Slide 34 (Unit 10): Dùng mẫu thiết kế sẵn (template) để hoàn thành báo cáo chính xác trong thời gian ngắn thể hiện tính Hiệu quả (Efficiency) trong viết văn bản.

questions.question: If a business writer carefully structures their report to present data and financial statistics in a highly logical and organized manner, which rhetorical element are they primarily utilizing?
options: Pathos, because financial data usually triggers a strong emotional response from investors.
Ethos, because utilizing structured formatting automatically proves the writer's high moral character.
Logos, because the writer is appealing to the audience's sense of reason and logical deduction.
Eros, because the writer wants the audience to feel passionate about the corporate budget.
questions.correct_answer: Logos, because the writer is appealing to the audience's sense of reason and logical deduction.
questions.explanation: Slide 30 (Unit 8–9): Sắp xếp dữ liệu và số liệu tài chính một cách logic, chặt chẽ nhằm thuyết phục lý trí người đọc là ứng dụng trụ cột Logos.

questions.question: What is NOT an example of artifacts?
options: Tattoos
Eyeglasses
Brand logos
Cars
Eye colour
questions.correct_answer: Eye colour
questions.explanation: Slide 28 (Unit 8 - Nonverbal Communication): Artifacts là những vật thể/phụ kiện do con người lựa chọn mang trên mình (hình xăm, kính mắt, logo, xe...); màu mắt tự nhiên (Eye colour) không phải artifact.

questions.question:
"Nonverbal cues cannot be isolated from the broader context of communication, nor can they be retracted once expressed."

Which characteristic of nonverbal communication is expressed in the above statement?
options: Irreversible
Immediate
Redundant
Easy to be misunderstood
Emotional
questions.correct_answer: Irreversible
questions.explanation: Slide 28 (Unit 8): Cụm 'nor can they be retracted once expressed' (không thể rút lại một khi đã thể hiện) chính là đặc tính Irreversible (không thể đảo ngược).

questions.question: Why is paying close attention to the specific subjects or tasks you genuinely look forward to considered a powerful strategy in career exploration?
options: Enjoyment serves as a highly reliable natural clue toward identifying true personal strengths and interests.
These subjects always guarantee the highest possible grades with the absolute lowest effort.
Instructors in those specific areas are legally obligated to act as official career mentors.
Those subjects are guaranteed by federal databases to offer the most practical open job vacancies.
questions.correct_answer: Enjoyment serves as a highly reliable natural clue toward identifying true personal strengths and interests.
questions.explanation: Slide 43 (Unit 13 - Career Exploration): Cảm giác hứng thú tự nhiên với môn học/công việc là tín hiệu đáng tin cậy giúp nhận diện thế mạnh và đam mê nghề nghiệp thực sự.

questions.question: When an interviewer asks a behavioral question such as "Describe a time you solved a problem in a team", what is the most effective approach for the candidate?
options: Give a broad, generalized statement about how teamwork is always vital in modern environments.
Use a structured method to share a specific, concise story highlighting real actions and measurable results.
Explain that no interpersonal or operational problems have ever occurred in past group projects.
Detail a complex situation where a teammate failed completely, focusing entirely on blaming that person.
questions.correct_answer: Use a structured method to share a specific, concise story highlighting real actions and measurable results.
questions.explanation: Slide 46 (Unit 13 - STAR Method): Khi trả lời câu hỏi hành vi (behavioral question), cần dùng cấu trúc rõ ràng (như STAR) kể câu chuyện cụ thể, nêu hành động thực tế và kết quả đo lường được.

questions.question: If a cover letter reads like a generic template, repeats the résumé word-for-word, and uses an overly informal greeting, what are the most critical steps to rewrite it?
options: Use a professional greeting, tailor the points to the specific company, and tell a deeper narrative.
Change the greeting to a more casual phrase, and copy the remaining text exactly as before.
Keep the generic text but insert multiple technical graphics to distract from the repetitive prose.
Remove the header details entirely and submit only the middle paragraph to save space on the page.
questions.correct_answer: Use a professional greeting, tailor the points to the specific company, and tell a deeper narrative.
questions.explanation: Slide 46 (Unit 13): Cover letter chuẩn phải chào hỏi trang trọng, cá nhân hóa theo công ty ứng tuyển và kể câu chuyện sâu sắc thay vì sao chép nguyên văn CV.

questions.question: Which can low emotional intelligence in university teams lead to?
options: Group withdrawal
High-quality work
Class misses
Group intelligence
Deadlines
questions.correct_answer: Group withdrawal
questions.explanation: Slide 19 (Unit 4 - EQ): EQ thấp trong nhóm đại học dẫn đến 3 hệ quả chính: trễ deadline, nỗ lực thấp và rút lui khỏi nhóm (Group withdrawal).

questions.question:
What is best illustrated in the following example?

"Hung is leading a major project launch, and his key software developer suddenly resigns two weeks before the deadline. He takes a breath and speaks to himself: 'Okay, this is a high-stakes stress test for our team. How can we reallocate our remaining resources to launch the project on time, and what can this teach us about documenting our processes better in the future?'"
options: Identifying problems as challenges
Expressing feelings in constructive ways
Practicing empathy
Focussing on problem-solving
Idea brainstorming
questions.correct_answer: Identifying problems as challenges
questions.explanation: Slide 19 (Unit 4 - Leadership Mindset & EQ): Thay vì hoảng loạn hay đổ lỗi khi gặp sự cố, việc tự nhủ 'đây là bài kiểm tra/thử thách' thể hiện tư duy nhìn nhận vấn đề như cơ hội thử thách (Identifying problems as challenges).

questions.question: What is a primary function of relationship-building roles within a team?
options: To enforce team decisions and ask for information.
To evaluate alternatives and choose the best options
To improve team cohesion by supporting motivation, empathy, and conflict handling.
To perform specific technical tasks required by the assignment
questions.correct_answer: To improve team cohesion by supporting motivation, empathy, and conflict handling.
questions.explanation: Slide 3 (Unit 1): Vai trò xây dựng quan hệ (Relationship-building roles) giúp duy trì hòa khí, động viên, thấu cảm và xử lý xung đột để tăng sự gắn kết nhóm.

questions.question: If a manager over-controls the team and prevents their autonomy, which factor is eroding team performance?
options: Poor delegation by managers.
Unwillingness to cooperate.
Lack of managerial support.
Groupthink.
questions.correct_answer: Poor delegation by managers.
questions.explanation: Slide 2 & 13 (Unit 1 & 4): Kiểm soát quá mức (micromanagement) và không trao quyền tự chủ chính là lỗi ủy quyền kém của người quản lý (Poor delegation by managers).

questions.question: How should a persuasive speaker utilize Maslow's hierarchy of needs when tailoring their message?
options: Always focus on self-actualization, as it is the most powerful motivator for all audiences.
Address the highest-level needs first to capture immediate interest.
Identify and appeal to the needs relevant to the audience's current situation before attempting to motivate higher-level desires.
Ignore Maslow's hierarchy, as it is outdated in modern business communication.
questions.correct_answer: Identify and appeal to the needs relevant to the audience's current situation before attempting to motivate higher-level desires.
questions.explanation: Slide 30 (Unit 9): Người thuyết phục cần xác định và đáp ứng đúng tầng nhu cầu phù hợp với hoàn cảnh hiện tại của khán giả trước khi kêu gọi các nhu cầu bậc cao hơn.

questions.question: Which of the following best illustrates a persuasive goal defined by a clear measurable gain?
options: Convincing the executive board that the company's current digital marketing strategy is outdated and inefficient.
Inspiring employees to appreciate the diverse cultural backgrounds of their global teammates during project collaboration.
Securing commitment from at least 40% of presentation attendees to sign up for the new corporate wellness beta platform before the end of the day.
Explaining the step-by-step technical specifications of a new cloud-based customer relationship management system.
questions.correct_answer: Securing commitment from at least 40% of presentation attendees to sign up for the new corporate wellness beta platform before the end of the day.
questions.explanation: Slide 30 (Unit 9): Mục tiêu thuyết phục có kết quả đo lường được (measurable gain) cần có con số/tỷ lệ cụ thể ('at least 40%') và mốc thời gian rõ ràng ('before the end of the day').

questions.question: What is NOT true about team meetings?
options: A part of how groups get work done
Members can have different feelings about the important of meetings.
A management tool
Can be replaced by emails
Help increase team cohesion
questions.correct_answer: Can be replaced by emails
questions.explanation: Slide 20 (Unit 5–6): Email chỉ thay thế được các thông báo/cập nhật đơn giản, KHÔNG thể thay thế hoàn toàn mọi cuộc họp nhóm (nhất là thảo luận chiến lược hay xử lý xung đột).

questions.question: Which case does not require a meeting agenda?
options: Daily check-in with team mates
Project mid-term review
Strategic discussion
Project outcome presentation
Client meeting
questions.correct_answer: Daily check-in with team mates
questions.explanation: Slide 20 (Unit 6): Trao đổi nhanh hằng ngày (Daily check-in) mang tính cập nhật ngắn gọn không cần agenda trang trọng như họp chiến lược, họp khách hàng hay review giữa kỳ.
